for Social Media Partners who will grow our presence by creating and posting content

?What you'll do?

2. Post other content we provide (videos & written posts) on your own accounts,

   so interested people can comment — we then follow up with those who engage

3. Grow and warm up local social media accounts (we provide the numbers & setup) —

   simple daily actions like liking, sharing, and commenting

4. Like and engage with direct-sales / networking-related profiles and content,

   which helps us reach the right audience more effectively for future campaigns

     this job is not for you.



?We're looking for?

- Background or experience in direct sales / network marketing / MLM (strongly preferred)

- Comfortable and natural speaking on camera in Taglish

- Active, genuine social media presence

- Reliable, consistent, follows daily task instructions



?Nice to have (not required)?

- A decent follower count on IG /
 / TikTok

- Experience creating video content



?Content & Image Use?

- We provide all scripts and content ideas — you don't need to write anything

- By filming for us, you agree we may re-use and lightly adapt the content you create

  for our marketing. A separate image/voice licensing fee applies if we use your

  likeness beyond your own posts (we'll agree this with you clearly in writing)



?Payment?

- Base: US$3/hour for daily tasks (posting, filming, liking, sharing, account warming)

- Activation bonus: US$[15-40] for every lead who signs up AND activates through

  people who engage with your content

- Monthly sprint bonus when you hit the monthly activation target

- Paid via GCash or Wise — bonuses weekly, hourly pay monthly

- PAID TRIAL: 2-week starter period



To apply, reply with:

1. Your direct sales / network marketing experience (which company, how long)

nts from our long-form videos and proactively turn them into engaging Shorts.



Who We're Looking For

-Is passionate about becoming one of the best video editors they can be

-Constantly studies YouTube and social media to improve their craft

What Success Looks Like

-Suggesting stronger hooks

nts likely to go viral

description:
We are looking for fast and reliable CapCut video editors to join our social media agency. We create content for restaurants across the United States and need editors who can turn raw footage into engaging Instagram Reels and TikTok videos.



We provide all of the inspiration videos, so your job is to recreate our editing style as closely as possible. Speed and consistency are extremely important.



Responsibilities

* Edit Instagram Reels and TikTok videos using CapCut

* Download raw footage from our content library

* Follow the inspiration videos exactly

* Add captions, transitions, sound effects, zooms, and other edits to match our style

* Deliver videos quickly while maintaining high quality

* Make revisions when needed



Requirements

* CapCut experience is required

* Strong understanding of Reels and TikTok editing

* Fast turnaround times

* Great attention to detail

* Reliable communication



How to Apply

To be considered, you must complete our editing sample test.



Dropbox:

title: Admin Support Coordinator
description:
Location: Tabuk City or surrounding Kalinga area, Philippines

Work arrangement: Full-time, work from home initially, transitioning to our future Tabuk City office

Reports to: Philippines Office Manager

About Elite Trades Australia

Elite Trades Australia is a Melbourne-based electrical and plumbing services company delivering residential, commercial, government, maintenance and energy-efficiency projects across Victoria. Our work includes electrical and plumbing services, hot-water and heat-pump installations, property upgrades, maintenance and project delivery.

We coordinate internal field teams and subcontractors through disciplined job-management, scheduling, compliance and documentation systems. Accuracy, ownership and timely escalation are essential to keeping our field operations running effectively.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-focused Field Service Admin Coordinator to support the administration, scheduling, documentation, and operational coordination of jobs for an Australian trades business.

You will manage jobs from the time a purchase order or confirmed booking is received through to job creation, desktop auditing, scheduling, field-worker allocation, subcontractor confirmation, variation processing, billing support, and records maintenance.

This position requires someone who takes ownership of unresolved matters, maintains accurate records, and ensures every job is properly prepared before its scheduled attendance date.

Key Responsibilities

• Same-day job creation. Create ServiceM8 job cards on the day a purchase order or confirmed booking is received; apply the correct status, including “Pending Details” where information is incomplete; and update required stakeholder and scheduling trackers without delay.

• Data integrity. Accurately enter and maintain customer, property, retailer, purchase-order and job information; create or update retailer records; and correct errors or changes immediately.

• Document control. Attach purchase orders, assessment reports, photographs, certificates and supporting evidence to the correct ServiceM8 job before it progresses, keeping ServiceM8 and all contractual trackers aligned.

• Pre-attendance desktop audits. Complete the final desktop review by the business day before attendance, covering clearances, switchboards, access, additional works, modifications, Location Insights and double-storey properties.

• Job readiness and allocation. Confirm standard jobs are booked and ready, assign next-day work across the required platforms, and verify that field workers and subcontractors can access their jobs on mobile devices.

• Escalation and queue ownership. Escalate missing, inaccessible or unassigned jobs—and any unresolved information or documentation—in the operational group and office chat; follow each issue through to resolution; and maintain the Runabout Waiting and Assigned Lists.

• Subcontractor administration. Obtain written confirmation before each subcontracted job, record it in WhatsApp, ServiceM8 and Excel, and enter the job in the Contractor Payment Tracker.

• Invoice readiness. Complete a final documentation check and prepare customer or retailer invoices only when the job record is complete, validating all charges against the purchase order, approved variations and completed works.

• Billing control. Maintain invoicing, accounts-receivable and billing trackers; identify completed but uninvoiced work; progress exceptions to resolution; and assist with invoice follow-up and outstanding-account reporting.

• Bookkeeping records. Maintain approved supplier and subcontractor records, contractor-payment information, supporting documents and basic transaction records, and provide the external bookkeeper with documentation required for reconciliations.

• Variation administration. Prepare draft variation documentation with the required photographs, reports and approvals, then update approved variations in ServiceM8 and the relevant billing records.

• Contractor invoice checks. Check subcontractor invoices against approved jobs, rates and variations, and escalate missing approvals, inconsistent amounts or incomplete evidence to the Philippines Office Manager.

• Compliance support. Organise certificates, photographs, audit evidence and job records, and flag missing, incorrect or inconsistent documentation before the job or invoice progresses.

• File and exception reporting. Maintain organised electronic files using consistent naming conventions and produce daily or weekly reports covering incomplete jobs, uninvoiced work, missing documents and unresolved data issues.

• Operational cover. Provide backup administrative support to the scheduling and customer-service functions during peak periods or staff leave.



Skills and Experience

• Proven experience in administration, job scheduling, operations coordination, or field-service support.

• Strong data-entry, Excel or Google Sheets, and record-management skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and written English.

• Experience with ServiceM8, Runabout, bookkeeping, or similar systems is desirable.

• Ability to manage deadlines, identify errors, escalate issues, and maintain accurate records.

• Reliable computer, stable internet, and availability during Australian business hours.



Performance Expectations

• New jobs must be created and entered on the same day they are received.

• Scheduled jobs must be fully audited and administratively ready by the day before attendance.

• Changes must be updated across all relevant systems immediately.

• Missing information, documents, assignments, or platform-access issues must be escalated promptly.

• No job should progress without the required documentation, checks, and confirmations.

• All operational, subcontractor, variation, billing, and bookkeeping records must remain accurate and current.



How to Apply and Location Details

Applicants should live in Tabuk City or within a practical commuting distance of Tabuk City.

This position will begin as a work-from-home role. The successful applicant must be willing and able to transition to working from our future Tabuk City office when it opens.

Please provide:

1. Your updated résumé.

2. A link to a 2–3-minute recorded video introduction using Loom, Google Drive, or a similar platform. In your video, please explain:

o Your previous administration or operations experience.

o Your experience with job scheduling, data entry, Excel, bookkeeping, or contractor coordination.

o Any experience using ServiceM8 or similar job-management software.

o How you maintain accuracy when managing multiple jobs and deadlines.

o Why you believe you are suitable for this position.

3. A screenshot of your current internet speed.

4. Details of your computer and backup internet or power arrangements.

5. A Photo of your workstation. At least 2 screens required.

6. Your availability to work Australian business hours.

title: Meta & Google Ads Specialist for Local Experience Business
description:
Please read this carefully before applying.



We are Sok Studios, a perfume workshop and experience business based in Auckland, New Zealand.



We have recently passed our first year in business and are looking for an experienced paid advertising specialist to help us understand what is working, improve our current campaigns, and build a stronger advertising system as we grow.



Before applying, please take a few minutes to review our business:



Instagram:





Website:





We would especially like to hear from people who have worked with local service businesses, experience-based businesses, workshops, events, hospitality, beauty, lifestyle, or businesses that generate bookings rather than traditional e-commerce sales.



ABOUT THE PROJECT



This will begin as a paid 4-week trial gig.



We are not currently looking for a full-time employee.



During the initial trial, we would like help with:



• Auditing our existing Meta Ads and Google Ads accounts

• Reviewing campaign structure, targeting, keywords and budgets

• Checking conversion tracking and identifying any tracking issues

• Recommending which services and audiences we should prioritise

• Setting up or improving selected campaigns

• Monitoring and optimising campaigns during the trial period

• Testing audiences, messaging and creatives where appropriate

• Providing a clear summary of what worked, what did not work, and what we should do next



Our services currently include:



• Small-group perfume workshops

• Private perfume workshops

• Bridal showers

• Hens parties

• Birthday parties

• Corporate events and team-building experiences



We already create our own photos and video content. You will not be responsible for video editing, but we would value someone who can give useful feedback on which creative angles, hooks or offers should be tested in ads.



EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Strong expertise in either Meta Ads or Google Ads is required.



Experience across both platforms is preferred, but please be honest about which platform is your strongest.



We are looking for someone with real hands-on experience in:



• Meta Ads Manager

• Google Ads

• Campaign setup and optimisation

• Conversion tracking

• Audience and keyword testing

• Local or booking-based businesses

• Analysing CPA, cost per lead, cost per booking and ROAS

• Explaining results clearly to a small-business owner



Please do not apply if your experience is mainly limited to boosting posts or completing online courses without managing real advertising budgets.



WHEN APPLYING, PLEASE INCLUDE:



1. Which platform are you strongest in: Meta Ads, Google Ads, or both?



2. What types of businesses have you managed ads for?



3. Have you worked with any local service, event, hospitality, workshop, beauty, lifestyle or booking-based businesses?



4. Please share one or two relevant case studies or examples, including:

   • The type of business

   • The advertising budget

   • The campaign period

   • The objective

   • The results

   • Exactly what you personally handled



Client names may be removed or anonymised, but we need enough information to understand the work and results.



5. What would you review first if you were auditing our current Meta and Google Ads accounts?



6. How many hours would you realistically need during the first four weeks, and what would you expect to complete during that time?



7. What is your hourly rate?



Please do not promise guaranteed results. We are more interested in honest analysis, clear reasoning and relevant experience.



The initial project will be a paid 4-week trial. If the work is useful and we work well together, there may be opportunities for ongoing monthly management or additional project-based work as Sok Studios grows.

mber feels supported, listened to, and valued, driving trust, growth, and creativity while building a lasting legacy of impact worldwide.  We are looking for one person to own and operate our technical stack: the website, the funnels, and the connected systems for
, automation, and tracking.



This is a dedicated in-house role. There is no agency-style client rotation, no looking for clients, and no handing off projects only to never see them finished. You build the systems, monitor their performance, and improve them. Because you run the stack, you see the long-term results of your work. It is an opportunity to take ownership and level up your skills as our systems evolve.



We are looking for a balanced skill set:



• Technical expertise: You know your way around GoHighLevel and Pabbly to build connected workflows, and tweaking PHP snippets does not slow you down.

• An eye for design: You can design, assemble and build clean, on-brand funnels and pages by yourself when we need to launch fast. This would keep projects moving forward without needing to wait on our design team.

• A curious mindset: You naturally look for ways to streamline operations and automate whatever manual work we did last month.



We are a small team with high standards. People here do what they said they would do, say when something has gone wrong, and are direct in their communications. If you need to be constantly hand-held or chased, this will not be a good fit. 



If you like owning a stack and making it better, we would like to hear from you.





--- WHAT YOU WILL DO ---

• Build, manage and optimize funnels and landing pages end-to-end in GoHighLevel and ClickFunnels 2.0, handling everything from layout to tracking.

 sequences and campaigns.

• Build and maintain weekly reporting dashboards.

• Monitor systems daily to catch failures, and either fix them or escalate appropriately.

• Leverage AI tools to accelerate bulk manual work like data migrations and site-wide updates.

• Proactively identify and propose better tools and automation strategies.

• Write standard operating procedures (SOPs) for everything you build.





--- WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR ---



REQUIRED



• Solid WordPress experience with a visual builder (Bricks preferred; Elementor or Oxygen acceptable).

• Comfortable editing PHP snippets.

• GoHighLevel and ClickFunnels 2.0 experience: funnels, workflows, products, contracts, forms, surveys, pipelines, and calendars.

title: GROWTH MARKETING COORDINATOR (CONTENT, CAMPAIGNS & MARKETING OPERATIONS) | B2B SAAS | AWARD-WINNING COMPANY
description:
Token of Trust is hiring a Growth Marketing Coordinator to support the day-to-day execution of our Growth team.



You will work directly with the Marketing Manager to help keep content, campaigns, research, marketing operations, and cross-functional projects moving forward with quality and consistency.



This role is ideal for someone who thrives on execution, research, organization, and continuous learning. You will contribute to content,
 campaigns, social media, market research, community engagement, and other growth initiatives across regulated industries.



The ideal candidate is proactive, resourceful, highly organized, and excited to learn complex industries quickly.



As you demonstrate reliability, judgment, and ownership, there is an opportunity to earn broader responsibility, increased compensation, and deeper ownership of content operations, campaign execution, marketing systems, or growth programs.



============================================================



ABOUT TOKEN OF TRUST



Token of Trust helps regulated ecommerce businesses keep selling with confidence.



We help merchants launch compliant checkout, verify customers when required, reduce compliance risk, and manage the reporting and evidence they need to operate in regulated markets.



Customers have rated Token of Trust 4.9 stars on G2, and G2 recognized us among the 2026 Top 50 Data Privacy Products. We have also been recognized for Best Support, Easiest To Do Business With, High Performer, and Users Most Likely To Recommend.



We operate on a hybrid Customer-Led Growth and Product-Led Growth model, combining customer insight-driven priorities with self-service product experiences.



Marketing helps make complex products and regulated workflows clear, credible, and useful for the businesses we serve. You will work in an environment that sits at the intersection of ecommerce, compliance, identity verification, trust, and growth.



============================================================



RESPONSIBILITIES



MARKETING EXECUTION & CONTENT OPERATIONS



- Own and maintain the marketing content calendar across blog,
, and social channels.

- Ensure content is scheduled in advance and published on time.

- Execute marketing campaigns across content,
, social media, partnerships, and community channels.

- Coordinate, build, and publish blog posts, landing pages, newsletters, and marketing assets.

- Schedule and manage content across WordPress, LinkedIn,
, and other platforms.

- Create or coordinate supporting graphics, social assets, and lightweight video content.

- Support campaign launches, QA, reporting, and other marketing initiatives.



PROJECT & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COORDINATION



- Create and manage Trello cards for all marketing initiatives and ensure work is properly documented.

- Ensure every task card includes a clear and complete description, acceptance criteria, story points, release notes, and supporting documentation when applicable.

- Track weekly priorities, manage sprint commitments, and surface blockers proactively.

- Intake and coordinate marketing requests from other departments and ensure timely follow-up.



OPERATIONS & REPORTING



- Support weekly reporting on marketing activities, performance metrics, and completed initiatives.

- Help maintain consistency across folder structures, naming conventions, UTMs, metadata, and documentation.

- Assist with marketing QA, process improvements, and operational best practices.

- Ensure marketing assets, campaigns, and activities are properly organized and documented.



============================================================



WHAT YOU BRING



CORE REQUIREMENTS



- 1-3 years of experience in marketing coordination, project management, editorial operations, content marketing, or a related role.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Comfortable managing projects in Trello or similar project-management tools.

- Experience using WordPress, social scheduling tools, and Google Workspace.

- Intermediate SEO knowledge, including keyword research, on-page optimization, internal linking, metadata, and basic content-performance analysis.

- Strong written communication skills.

- Experience using Canva, Figma, or similar tools to create marketing visuals and short-form content.

- Ability to work with meaningful overlap during U.S. Central Time business hours.



WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED



- You are proactive and enjoy taking ownership of tasks from start to finish.

- You can research customer pain points, competitors, industry trends, and unfamiliar topics independently.

- You can turn technical, regulatory, or industry-specific concepts into clear, practical marketing content.

- You use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms to improve research, content creation, and productivity.

- You are curious and enjoy learning about regulated industries, compliance, identity verification, and emerging technologies.

- Familiarity with B2B SaaS marketing, ecommerce, and content-performance reporting is a plus.



============================================================



SCHEDULE



- Remote independent contractor role.

- Minimum 20 hours per week required.

- Meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours is required.

- Opportunity to expand to full-time, 40 hours per week, based on business needs, role fit, and performance.

- Please include your timezone, preferred working hours, and the amount of overlap you can provide with U.S. business hours in your application.



============================================================



COMPENSATION



Compensation depends on experience, availability, scope, and demonstrated ability to own marketing coordination and operational responsibilities.



Expected monthly compensation for a part-time schedule is $260-$650 per month, depending on agreed weekly hours and experience.



Candidates who grow into a full-time schedule may be considered for a monthly compensation range of $520-$1,040 per month, depending on scope, performance, and business needs.



Please include your expected monthly compensation in your application.



============================================================



HOW TO APPLY



Use this subject line:



TRUST - Growth Marketing Coordinator Application



Please send:



1. RESUME OR LINKEDIN PROFILE

- Include a link to your most up-to-date resume, LinkedIn profile, or portfolio.



2. COMPENSATION AND AVAILABILITY

- Confirm that you reviewed the compensation ranges listed above and that they fit within your expected monthly compensation.

- List your expected monthly compensation.

- List your hours available per week.

- List your timezone.

- List your preferred working hours.

- State the amount of overlap you can provide with U.S. Central Time business hours.

- State your earliest possible start date.



3. MARKETING OWNERSHIP STORY

- In 5-8 sentences, describe one marketing campaign, content workflow, project-coordination challenge, or publishing process you owned from start to finish.

- Explain what happened, what you did, how you kept the work organized, and what changed as a result.



4. PROCESS IMPROVEMENT EXAMPLE

- Briefly describe one calendar, workflow, QA checklist, reporting process, Trello setup, SOP, or handoff you improved.



5. SHORT WRITTEN EXERCISE

A campaign is scheduled to launch in three days, but the landing page is incomplete, design assets are missing, and approval status is unclear.



Please answer:

- What would you do first?

- What information would you gather?

- Who would you involve and why?

- How would you organize the work and keep stakeholders updated through launch?



6. AI USAGE NOTE

Tell us how you used AI, if at all, to complete this application:

- Which sections did AI help with?

- Where did you rely on your own judgment?

- How did you verify that your final answer reflected your actual experience and thinking?



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be reviewed.



============================================================



HIRING PROCESS



After initial application review, selected candidates may be asked to confirm role requirements, compensation fit, long-term interest, independent-contractor status, no agency or subcontracting relationship, time-tracking expectations, background-check willingness, and integrity expectations.



Finalists may be asked to complete a short intro video and a paid trial project before final interviews.

"

Never send the same exact message to two accounts in a row — rotate variants

 or the link in the first message — let them ask or respond positively first

- Ticket links

- ClickUp

- Internal messages

Internal tea
mbers, to make sure requests reach the right person and delivery work has what it needs

mber

mbers, and third-party contacts

Being a strong operator is.

A creative role

A sales role

A role where you wait passively for instructions

title: RIGHT-HAND ASSISTANT - E-COMMERCE, SOCIAL & AI WORKFLOWS (FULL-TIME, LONG-TERM)
description:
Read this before applying - it will save us both time.



We're not hiring a virtual assistant who works from a task list. We're hiring one person we can hand an OUTCOME to - "keep the Etsy shops selling," "get our music app in front of more families" - who then goes and makes it happen. If you are not proactive, eager to learn and a go-getter please do not apply.



Most of this job is figuring out the how. We'll tell you what needs to be true; we don't always tell you the steps, because we expect you to be proactive and take more off our plate. If that sounds energizing, read on. If it sounds stressful, this genuinely isn't the right role and we'd rather you skip it.



ABOUT US



MMC Media is a small US-based company - the owner plus five people. We run three things:



- A family-safe music streaming app. 5,000+ original songs across 22 genres: pop, rock, country, hip-hop, R&B, electronic, folk, indie and more. Built for parents who want their kids listening to real, current-sounding music without explicit content. It's a mainstream catalog - pop-forward, not a religious app. (We'll tell you the name when we talk.)



- Etsy shops. Digital printables and downloads. Needs attention every single day (about 1 hour).



- Social and content. Several accounts across Pinterest, TikTok, Instagram,
 and YouTube for our blogs.



Honest about our stage: the app is live with real users but early on revenue. You'd be joining to help build something, not to maintain a machine that already runs. Systems are half-built, some things are messy, and you'll often be the first person to do a given task. If you want a large, stable, fully-documented company, you'd be unhappy here. Our other businesses are stable and have more consistent processes and revenue.



WHAT YOU'D OWN



App growth (primary)

- Social content: planning, scheduling and publishing across our accounts - then reading what actually worked and changing the plan because of it.

- Customer support for app users - fast responses, spotting recurring complaints, telling us what you're seeing.

- Launch and campaign support: getting things out the door on time.



Etsy shops (live revenue - this can't slip)

- Customer messages answered every day, without exception.

- Promotions and sales running continuously.

- Listing SEO, publishing new products, watching which listings earn and which don't.

- Keyword research to help us find new listing.

- Using our AI processes to help create new products and listings



AI-driven operations

- Use AI daily - and improve how the work gets done, not just do it faster.

- Bring us new tools and workflows. Part of this job is staying current and telling US what changed.



Reporting

- One brief written report of what you accomplished that day.



Later - not at the start

- This role has the potential to grow into coordinating one or two other people as we grow. That's the direction, not your first-months job, and we won't pretend otherwise. You should have leadership skills as we hope this role will grow into something more.



THE DETAILS



- Full-time, 40 hours/week, long-term.

- Starting at $500/month. Raises here come from results, not from time served - people who deliver have earned multiple increases. If you're asking for more than $500, apply anyway and tell us your number and why. We'd rather talk about it than miss the right person over a starting figure.



- Based in the Philippines, with flexibility to overlap U.S. Mountain Time occasionally for a call.

- We use TeamLogger for time tracking.

- Flexible schedule - days, nights, spread out, weekends. As long as you are consistently working throughout the week and turning in meaningful work.

- PTO after 6 months full-time.

- Paid time to learn. Training happens on the clock.



WHAT WE'RE LIKE TO WORK FOR



- We train people properly and pay for the time it takes.

- We give direct, specific feedback - you'll always know where you stand.

- We're accommodating with real life when you communicate with us. We've carried people through hard stretches. What we can't work with is disappearing.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through the form here:



Please don't send a separate cover letter - we won't read one. The form is what we read.



A couple of the questions ask you to go look at something before you answer them. Please actually do that part. Those answers matter far more to us than a polished resume, and they're what we read first.



What happens after you apply:



1. We read every application.

2. Shortlisted candidates send us a short recorded intro (about 2 minutes) or hop on a quick call - we want to hear how you explain things, since this role involves calls.

3. Finalists do a paid test project - real work, paid at your rate. That's where we both find out whether this fits.



We know applying takes real time. We'll get back to you either way.

title: Virtual Assistant – Micro-Influencer Research
description:
We are a Canadian handmade craft business looking for one reliable Virtual Assistant to research micro-influencers and content creators who may be a good match for our laser-cut wooden resin-outline kits.



Our wooden outlines are designed to be filled with jewellery resin to create ornaments, suncatchers, magnets, and decorative craft projects.



The main purpose of this position is to build an accurate spreadsheet of relevant micro-influencers for future product gifting, tutorials, reviews, affiliate partnerships, and promotional collaborations.



This role is focused on research and lead generation only. Do not contact influencers unless specifically instructed.



Main responsibilities



• Research micro-influencers and content creators on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest,
, blogs, and other approved platforms

• Find creators whose content is relevant to resin crafts, jewellery resin, UV resin, epoxy resin, laser-cut crafts, ornament making, suncatchers, craft kits, handmade gifts, or DIY projects

• Identify creators whose audiences are likely to purchase or use resin craft products

• Prioritize creators in Canada and the United States when requested

• Review recent posts to confirm that the creator is active and relevant

• Record all researched creators in a provided spreadsheet

• Locate publicly available business
 addresses or official contact methods

• Record follower counts, average views, engagement indicators, location, platform links, niche, and contact information

• Include links to examples of relevant content

• Note whether the creator mentions gifted collaborations, affiliate programs, product reviews, tutorials, sponsorships, or user-generated content

• Explain briefly why the creator may or may not be suitable

• Identify suspicious engagement, unrelated audiences, inactive accounts, or poor-quality leads

• Avoid duplicate creators

• Mark missing information as “Not Found” or “Unconfirmed” rather than guessing

• Follow the provided research criteria carefully



Creator niches may include



• Resin art

• Jewellery-resin crafts

• UV-resin or epoxy-resin tutorials

• Laser-cut and Glowforge crafts

• Ornament and suncatcher making

• Handmade craft kits

• DIY home décor

• Craft-product demonstrations and reviews

• Small craft businesses

• Handmade gift content



Spreadsheet information may include



• Creator name

• Account or channel name

• Primary platform

• Profile link

• Additional platform links

• Country or location

• Primary craft niche

• Follower or subscriber count

• Average views or engagement indicators

• Date of most recent post

• Public business
 or contact method

• Relevant content links

• Collaboration types mentioned

• Reason the creator is suitable or unsuitable

• Lead result: YES, NO, or REVIEW

• Notes or concerns



Lead classifications



YES – Strong Lead: The creator is active, relevant, has suitable content, and appears to have genuine audience engagement.



NO – Not Suitable: The creator is inactive, irrelevant, has suspicious engagement, or clearly does not match the product.



REVIEW – More Information Needed: The creator may be suitable, but important information could not be confirmed.



Record all creators that are fully researched, including NO and REVIEW results. Accuracy and relevance are more important than producing a large number of leads.



The ideal applicant



• Has experience with influencer research, lead generation, social-media research, or online prospecting

• Understands micro-influencer marketing

• Can distinguish relevant craft creators from general lifestyle accounts

• Can recognize authentic engagement rather than relying only on follower count

• Is comfortable researching TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, and other platforms

• Is comfortable using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel

• Pays close attention to names, links, locations, follower counts, and contact details

• Does not invent
 addresses or missing information

• Can work independently and solve routine research problems

• Follows written instructions and checks available information before asking questions

• Has reliable internet and good written English



Schedule



This is one ongoing part-time position for approximately 10 hours per week, normally completed as about two hours per day, five days per week.



Applicants may have other clients or employment, provided they can consistently complete the assigned work and meet deadlines. Additional hours are not guaranteed.



Selected applicants may be asked to complete a small paid research trial.



Application instructions



Put the word CRAFT at the beginning of your application subject line.



Please answer:



Have you previously researched influencers, creators, or social-media leads?

Which platforms are you most experienced researching?

How would you determine whether a creator is a good match for a resin craft product?

How would you recognize weak or suspicious engagement?

What information would you record in an influencer spreadsheet?

What experience do you have with Google Sheets or Excel?

Can you consistently work approximately two hours per day, five days per week?

title: Customer Success & Operations Coordinator - FULL TIME & HIGH PAY
description:
Customer Success & Operations Coordinator (Remote, Full-Time)



Location: Remote



Schedule: Full-Time | Arizona Business Hours (MST)



Compensation: $8-$15 USD/hour (DOE) 



Help People When They Need It Most.



We're not looking for "just another virtual assistant."



We're looking for someone who genuinely cares about people.



Someone who takes ownership.



Someone who notices problems before anyone else does.



Someone who wants to build a long-term career with a company that values integrity, teamwork, and doing the right thing.



If that sounds like you, keep reading. Make sure to read the ENTIRE POST and follow ALL INSTRUCTIONS or your application will not be considered. 



Who We Are



For the past 14 years, we've been helping homeowners and businesses throughout Arizona recover from some of the most stressful situations they'll ever experience.



Water damage.



Fire damage.



Mold.



Asbestos.



Storm damage.



Roof leaks.



When customers call us, they're often overwhelmed, frustrated, or unsure what to do next.



Our job isn't just to repair their property.



It's to give them confidence that everything is going to be okay.



We're proud of the reputation we've built.



Many of our employees have been with us for 10+ years, and we're looking for someone who wants to become part of that family.



We're building something special, and we want people who want to grow with us for years to come.



Why You'll Love Working Here



We believe great people deserve a great place to work.



When you join our team, you'll find:



A respectful, supportive team that genuinely enjoys working together.

Long-term, stable employment.

Weekly pay.

Ongoing training and coaching.

Modern software and AI tools that make your job easier.

Opportunities for increased responsibility, promotions, and higher pay as the company grows.

A company that values your ideas and encourages continuous improvement.

Meaningful work that truly helps people during difficult times.



This isn't just another remote job.



We're looking for someone who wants to build a career.



About the Position



As our Customer Success & Operations Coordinator, you'll become one of the most important members of our company.



You'll often be the first person customers speak with.



You'll help guide them through difficult situations while keeping projects organized from the initial phone call through final payment.



You'll work closely with our office staff, technicians, project managers, customers, insurance companies, and vendors to make sure every project moves smoothly.



If you enjoy helping people, solving problems, staying organized, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks, you'll love this position.



Your Mission



Your mission is simple:



Deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Keep projects organized and moving forward.

Communicate proactively.

Solve problems before they become bigger.

Help our team operate at a high level every day.

What You'll Do

Customer Success

Answer inbound phone calls professionally.

Schedule appointments.

Respond to customer
s and text messages.

Follow up with leads and existing customers.

Keep customers informed throughout their project.

Build trust through excellent communication.

Operations Coordination

Track projects from start to finish.

Coordinate schedules between customers and technicians.

Keep project files organized inside our CRM.

Ensure documents and authorizations are completed.

Identify potential issues before they become problems.

Support multiple departments throughout the day.

Sales Support

Follow up on estimates.

Schedule follow-up appointments.

Document conversations accurately.

Help customers make informed decisions.

Billing & Collections

Verify deposits.

Track progress payments.

Follow up professionally on unpaid invoices.

Keep accurate payment records.

Insurance Coordination

Communicate with insurance representatives.

Track claim progress.

Ensure documentation is submitted promptly.

The Type of Person Who Thrives Here



You'll probably love this job if you:



Take ownership without being asked.

Naturally stay organized.

Enjoy helping people.

Communicate confidently and professionally.

Stay calm under pressure.

Learn software quickly.

Like solving problems.

Pay close attention to details.

Are dependable and keep your commitments.

Constantly look for ways to improve.



This Position Is NOT For You If...

You dislike talking with customers.

You need constant supervision.

You frequently miss deadlines.

You struggle with multitasking.

You avoid responsibility.

You don't enjoy learning new things.

You prefer repetitive work with little interaction.

You have unreliable internet or a noisy work environment.

You're only looking for a temporary job.

Minimum Qualifications

Excellent spoken English that is clear and easily understood by U.S. customers.

Excellent written English.

Previous customer service experience over the phone.

Reliable high-speed internet (25 Mbps minimum).

Quiet home office.

Reliable computer.

Professional USB headset.

Comfortable working Arizona business hours.

Experience That Will Help You Stand Out



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



Construction

Restoration

Roofing

Insurance claims

Scheduling

Customer service

Collections

CRM software

Google Workspace

GoHighLevel

JobNimbus

Dialpad



Don't worry if you don't have experience in every area.



We're happy to train the right person who has the right attitude.



Growth Opportunities



We promote from within whenever possible.



As our company continues to grow, this position can grow into opportunities such as:



Senior Customer Success Coordinator

Team Lead

Executive Assistant



We reward people who consistently take ownership and deliver excellent work.



How to Apply



To be considered, please submit all of the following:



Resume

Internet speed test screenshot

Computer specifications screenshot

One 45-60 second audio recording reading the script below

One 3-5 minute LOOM video or other, answering the questions below



Applications missing requested items will NOT be considered.



Audio Recording



Please read the following exactly as written.



We use this recording to evaluate:



Communication skills

Confidence

Professionalism

Pace

Ability to make customers feel comfortable



"Thank you for calling Zona Restoration. This is [Name]. How may I help you today?



I'm sorry to hear you're dealing with water damage. I'll help schedule your inspection as quickly as possible.



Before we begin, I'd like to verify your address and phone number.



Our technician will inspect the affected areas, document the moisture readings, and discuss the mitigation process.



Your appointment is scheduled for 4821 East Guadalupe Road Phoenix, on Thursday, the thirteenth, at 3:30 p.m.



If you have insurance, we'll help coordinate the claim and collect the necessary documentation.



Video Questions



Please answer all of the following questions in one 3-5 minute video.



Tell us about yourself professionally.

Describe your customer service experience.

What accomplishment are you most proud of in your previous job?

Describe a mistake you made at work and what you learned from it.

Why do you believe you'd be a great fit for this role?



Final Step



To show you've carefully read this job posting, begin your application with the words:



HIRING MANAGER



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be reviewed.



One Final Thought



We're not looking for the person with the most impressive resume.



We're looking for someone who genuinely cares about helping people, takes pride in their work, communicates exceptionally well, and wants to become an important part of our team.



If you're looking for a company where your work matters, where you'll be respected, and where you can build a long-term career with great people, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Video Editor (Ads) — For E-Commerce Brand
description:
We're an 8-figure DTC e-commerce brand scaling fast on Meta. We move quickly, test aggressively, and only work with people who can keep up. No corporate politics. No slow feedback loops. Just a sharp, serious team obsessed with one thing: making ads that convert.



We're building something big. We want editors who want to grow with us.



---



The Role



You'll take scripts, raw UGC footage, and creator clips — and turn them into scroll-stopping, high-converting video ads for Meta 
 & Instagram).



This is a performance role, not a content role. Your edits need to sell. Every frame, every cut, every caption has one job: move the viewer from hook to CTA without losing them.



You'll be expected to use AI tools daily to move faster and produce more. If you're not already using tools like Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, VEO, Kling,... - this is not for you

---



## What You'll Do



- Execute **15–20 briefs per week** for Meta

- Turn scripts, UGC, testimonials, and raw footage into polished, direct-response ads

- Produce multiple variations per concept — different hooks, intros, pacing, and CTAs

- Add captions, b-roll, motion graphics, and visual effects that drive retention.

- Use AI tools (voiceovers, avatars, video generation, asset creation) to speed up output and improve quality

- Source supplementary footage and stock when needed.

- Apply feedback fast — iterate based on performance data.

- Deliver in all required Meta formats (9:16, 1:1, 4:5) with clean file organization.



---



## Requirements



- **Minimum 1–2 years editing DTC video ads** (portfolio required)

- **Strong experience with AI tools** — this is non-negotiable. Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, VEO, or similar must already be part of your daily workflow.

- Proven track record editing high-converting ads for Meta 
 & Instagram)

- Deep understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, visual hierarchy, and direct-response structures

- Ability to read a brief and execute precisely — no hand-holding, no back-and-forth

- Proficient in your editing tool of choice (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci — we don't care, as long as your work is sharp)

- Fluent written and spoken English

- Fast, responsive, and able to deliver under deadlines

- Reliable internet and remote work setup



---

## Compensation & Schedule



- **Salary:** $1,000/month to $1,500/month based on experience

- **Schedule:** Full-time

- **Output:** 15–20 briefs per week

- **Growth:** Clear path to senior creative roles with increased pay for editors who deliver consistently

---



## How to Apply



**To be considered, you MUST show us your portfolio. No portfolio, no reply.**



Send us:



1. Your portfolio or reel — DTC Meta ads you've personally edited (paid ad work only, no passion projects, no wedding videos, no brand films). This is the #1 thing we look at.

2. A short note telling us which AI tools you currently use in your workflow and how.

3. The names of DTC brands you've worked with.



**Start your application with the word "EDITZZ" at the very top** to prove you read this entire post.



Applications without a portfolio, without "EDITZZ", or with generic reels will be ignored.



We reply fast to strong applications. If your work is sharp, we'll move you to a paid trial task immediately.



Looking forward to finding our next killer.

title: AI Website Builder/ Multi-Brand Website Designer
description:
About Us

The Sourcing Co. (TSC) is a sourcing, trading and manufacturing group with operations across Singapore, China, Papua New Guinea and Australia. We run multiple brands across merchandise, apparel and fashion, and building supplies and hardware.



The Role

We are rebuilding our brand websites, starting with TSC Supply (tscsupply.co), our building materials and manufacturing sourcing brand.



We are looking for someone who builds websites using AI, and who has a real portfolio to prove it. Not simple one-page landing sites. We mean fully interactive, functional, customer-facing websites that can carry quote requests, catalogs, product categories and multiple content types.



Once TSC Supply is live, this becomes an ongoing role rebuilding and maintaining websites across our other brands.



What You Will Do

- Rebuild tscsupply.co into a modern, interactive, aesthetically strong website using AI-native design and build tools

- Take our direction (framework, brand references, and images provided via shared drive) and translate it into a cohesive, professional site

- Bring your own creative and layout suggestions. We want a collaborator, not just someone who executes a brief

- Build out full site functionality: navigation, product/category pages, quote request forms, catalog downloads, image galleries, responsive layouts across devices

- Once TSC Supply is complete, apply the same process to our other brand sites

- Handle ongoing updates, iterations and small fixes post-launch



What You Need

- Provide us a portfolio. Show us 2 to 3 live, functioning websites you built using AI tools, for real customer-facing businesses. - Simple landing pages will not be considered.

- Your portfolio should show range: different layouts, industries, and levels of interactivity

- Strong sense of design, typography, and UX. You should be able to say "this would look better if..." and be right

- Comfortable working from a creative brief but also proposing your own direction

- Experience with AI website building tools and workflows (Framer AI, Webflow AI, Wix Studio AI, Durable, or AI-assisted custom code, etc.)

- Able to manage multiple brand projects at once without close supervision

- Strong written English for async communication



Nice to have

- Experience building B2B, catalog-style, or trade/manufacturing-facing websites

- Basic SEO knowledge

- Comfortable touching up related brand assets (decks, social graphics) if needed



What We Provide

- Brand direction and a working framework for TSC Supply

- Reference images and brand assets via shared drive

- Direct feedback loop, you will work closely with our GM and Director

Edit approximately three to five short-form videos each week from footage provided by leadership.

Repurpose videos for Instagram Reels,

Schedule approved content using the organization’s social-media tools.

Write professional captions related to mental health, recovery, substance-use awareness, housing stability, workforce development, community partnerships, fundraising, and nonprofit impact.

Repurpose existing materials into newsletters, stakeholder updates, donor communications, and
 campaigns.

Build organized outreach lists of appropriate referral partners, community organizations, donors, sponsors, businesses, and other external stakeholders using legitimate public business information.

Send approved outreach messages and follow-up communications.

Update outreach and lead-generation trackers so every contact has a clear status and next step.

Monitor comments and messages using approved response guidelines.

Immediately escalate messages involving crisis, su

title: Nonprofit Grant Research, Sponsorship & Fundraising Development Specialist
description:
About Our Community Home



Our Community Home, Inc. is a Richmond, Virginia nonprofit supporting people facing mental-health challenges, substance-use recovery, housing instability, unemployment, and related barriers.



Our programs and initiatives include housing and recovery support, mental-health awareness, workforce development, community partnerships, resource connection, and community programming. We are looking for a resourceful specialist who can help us build a disciplined year-round funding and fundraising pipeline.



About the Position



We need more than someone who performs generic internet searches or produces lists of grants without evaluating eligibility.



The Grant Research and Fundraising Development Specialist will identify appropriate funding opportunities, evaluate organizational fit, maintain a funding calendar, support grant applications, research sponsors and donors, and develop practical fundraising concepts.



What You Will Own

Research federal, state, local, foundation, community-foundation, corporate, healthcare, banking, mental-health, substance-use, housing, workforce-development, small nonprofit, and micro-grant opportunities.

Review eligibility, geographic restrictions, funding priorities, typical award amounts, deadlines, required registrations, matching requirements, reporting requirements, and application effort.

Research funders’ previous awards, Form 990 information, stated priorities, geographic focus, and likely organizational fit.

Create and maintain a 12-month grant and funding calendar.

Score opportunities based on mission alignment, eligibility, competitiveness, award potential, deadline, relationship potential, and application effort.

Recommend which opportunities the organization should pursue, monitor, or decline.

Create and maintain a centralized grant-document library.

Develop reusable organizational language covering mission, need, population served, program descriptions, outcomes, partnerships, sustainability, and organizational capacity.

Draft letters of inquiry, concept papers, application narratives, cover letters, and supporting documents.

Coordinate document requests and submission checklists.

Maintain a pipeline showing prospects, deadlines, assigned responsibilities, submission status, follow-up dates, and decisions.

Research local and national corporate sponsors and philanthropic partners.

Develop organized sponsor prospect lists and recommended outreach approaches.

Help create sponsorship packages, donor communications, and outreach templates.

Develop practical fundraising concepts for different points in the year, including community events, awareness campaigns, digital campaigns, corporate sponsorships, peer-to-peer efforts, recurring giving, and mission-aligned partnerships.

Prepare concise weekly updates describing findings, recommendations, risks, deadlines, and decisions needed from leadership.

First 30-Day Deliverables



The initial engagement will focus on producing:



A clean funding pipeline with approximately 20–30 genuinely qualified opportunities.

A prioritized list of the 10 strongest opportunities, including detailed fit assessments.

A 12-month grant and application calendar.

A centralized grant-document checklist and missing-document report.

A list of approximately 25 qualified corporate or institutional sponsorship prospects.

Four well-developed fundraising concept briefs.

At least one draft letter of inquiry or concept-paper outline for an approved opportunity.



Quality and fit are more important than producing a large number of generic prospects.



Required Qualifications

At least two years of experience researching or supporting U.S. nonprofit grants, fundraising, sponsorships, or institutional development.

Demonstrated experience with mental health, behavioral health, recovery, housing, homelessness, workforce development, human services, community development, or related causes is strongly preferred.

Strong understanding of how to evaluate a grant beyond keyword matching.

Excellent research, writing, proofreading, and organizational skills.

Experience reviewing funder websites, Form 990 information, past grant recipients, corporate-giving programs, community foundations, 
, 
, and other relevant resources.

Ability to distinguish between research, proposal drafting, program design, budget development, and final organizational approval.

Strong Google Sheets and Google Docs skills.

Ability to document the source and date of every funding opportunity.

Ability to verify AI-assisted research and writing rather than submitting unverified or generic AI output.

Willingness to protect donor, organizational, financial, and client information.

Important Expectations

You may support proposal drafting, but leadership will approve all final program descriptions, budgets, certifications, outcomes, and submissions.

You may not exaggerate organizational capacity, results, partnerships, or program data.

You may not submit an application without written authorization.

Compensation is hourly or project-based. It will not be calculated as a percentage of funds sought or awarded.

How to Apply



Use the subject line:



OCH GRANTS 2026



Include:



Your résumé.

A description of your U.S. nonprofit grant experience.

A redacted writing sample, grant prospect profile, letter of inquiry, or proposal excerpt.

A list of research tools and funding databases you have used.

One example of an opportunity you recommended an organization pursue and why.

One example of an opportunity you recommended an organization decline and why.

A clear explanation of your role in any grants that were awarded. Do not imply that you secured an award if you only performed limited research or editing.

Your weekly availability and desired hourly rate.

Confirmation that you are willing to complete a paid research and writing assessment.

Paid Skills Assessment



Finalists will receive a paid assessment of approximately four hours. Using publicly available and non-confidential information, the applicant may be asked to:



Identify five potential funding opportunities.

Rank them by fit.

Explain eligibility and potential concerns.

Create a short funding calendar.

Draft a one-page letter-of-inquiry outline.

Identify several possible corporate sponsors.

title: B2B Software Sales Specialist — US Market
description:
JOB TYPE: Part-time (20–25 hrs/week), OR full-time 40 hours per week



SALARY: $7 - 8/hour paid + commission (20,000–100,000 per closed sale) HOURS: US Eastern Time business hours



Read this whole post before applying. Applications that skip the instructions at the bottom will not be opened.



What this is



We are a small US software company. We built a Windows application that completely automates the billing and paperwork for a very specific American professional: an independent vocational rehabilitation case manager who helps injured workers return to work, and who bills the state workers' compensation system for her time.



Right now she types the same information four separate times — into a daily spreadsheet, a weekly written report, a claim form, and a payment tracker — then faxes it. Our software means she types it once and everything else generates automatically. Our first customer went from losing entire mornings on paperwork, to just being able to complete it all in minutes.



Nobody else has built this. There is no competitor. She has never had a software company understand her job.



Your job is to find these people, get them on the phone, and get them to look at it.

Why this role is unusual — please read carefully



This is not a volume dialing job. If you are looking for a job where you make 80–150 calls a day, this is the wrong post and you will hate this work.



There are only about 100–150 of these professionals in the state we're starting with. That is the entire market. We cannot buy more of them.



That means every single call matters. Burning through the list with a rushed pitch destroys the campaign permanently. We need someone who will make 40 excellent calls a week, not 400 mediocre ones.



You will spend as much time researching who these people are as you will spend calling them.



Who you'll be calling



Typically a woman, 45 to 65 years old, who has run her own practice for 15 to 30 years. She works alone, often from home. She has a master's degree and professional certifications. She handles confidential medical information. She is not technical and does everything in Word and Excel by choice. She has almost no online presence.



She has never been called by a software company that understood her job.



High-energy, high-pressure selling will fail instantly with this person. She responds to someone who has clearly done their homework, asks good questions, and is patient. Your credibility comes entirely from sounding like you understand her work.



You will need to learn the US workers' compensation vocabulary — BWC, MCOs, W-codes, CMS-1500 forms. We'll train you and pay you while you learn it. But you have to be the kind of person who can absorb a technical subject and speak about it confidently within a week.



What you'll actually do



Research and verify who is genuinely still practising (many public listings are outdated)

Manually dial — no auto-dialers, for US legal compliance

Have real conversations: ask about their process, find where the pain is

Book demos for our team

Ask for referrals — this community is invisible online and they all know each other

Keep detailed notes; with a list this small, everything you learn is valuable

Report back on what you're hearing so we can improve the approach



The first week is genuinely exploratory: validating the list, testing angles, and learning what actually resonates. We're not expecting sales in week one. We're expecting intelligence.



Requirements — please be honest with yourself



You must have:



3+ years of B2B outbound phone sales to the US market

Experience selling software or SaaS to small businesses or solo professionals (not enterprise, not consumers)

Experience representing a company the prospect has never heard of

A track record of learning a technical or regulated field (healthcare, insurance, legal, finance, compliance)

Genuinely consultative style — you ask questions before you pitch

Clear, calm, natural English. Warmth matters more than a perfect accent.

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, good headset

Ability to work US Eastern Time business hours



Big plus:



Sold into US healthcare, medical billing, insurance, or workers' compensation

Have done customer discovery or research interviews for a startup

Have built your own prospect lists

Have worked a niche market with under 1,000 total possible customers



Please do not apply if:



Your background is only inbound sales and customer service

You measure your work in calls per day

Your experience is only for generic lead generation (SEO, web design, solar, insurance, credit repair)

You need a script to have a conversation

You would describe yourself as "money hungry" — this list needs patience, not hunger

Compensation



Paid pilot week: $7–8 USD/hour for 20–25 hours, based on experience. No sales targets. You'll research, call, explore, and write up what you learn.



After the pilot, for the right person:



Base: $7–8 USD/hour

2,500 per demo booked that actually happens

20,000 per closed solo customer

35,000 per closed professional-tier customer

75,000–100,000 per multi-user practice customer



This can be a short project or a long-term role. That depends on results, and honestly, on whether you enjoy it. If this campaign works, there are five more US states behind it.



How to apply — follow this exactly



1. Subject line must be exactly: VOCREHAB SPECIALIST — [Your Name]



2. In your message, answer these three questions briefly:



What software or SaaS product have you sold to US small businesses, and what did it do?

What is the most technical or complicated subject you've had to learn in order to sell something?

Why does a market with only 150 possible customers require a different approach than a big one?



3. Record a voice message at 
 and paste the link in your application.



Go to 
, click record, speak for 5 to 10 minutes, then paste the share link into your application.



Please speak naturally. Do not read from a script or from anything AI-written — we can tell immediately, and it's an automatic no. We want to hear how you actually talk on a call.



Cover these four things, in order:



(a) Walk us through one specific B2B deal you sold. Name the company, what they did, what they were using before, what their objection was, and what changed their mind.



(b) Tell us about a product you had to learn from scratch. How did you learn it, and how long before you were comfortable talking to prospects about it?



(c) Answer this out loud, exactly as you would on a real call:



You've called a 55-year-old woman in Ohio who has run her own vocational rehabilitation practice for 25 years. She does all her billing by hand in Word and Excel. She's never heard of you or our company. Thirty seconds into the call she says:



"I've been doing this for 25 years. I don't need software."



Say word for word exactly what you would say next.



(d) Tell us about a deal you lost, and what you would do differently now.





**Applications missing the Vocaroo link will not be reviewed. Applications with the wrong subject line will not be opened.



We're looking for one person. We'd rather wait for the right one.

title: Full-Time Web Developer – Shopify to Cloudflare Migration

* New landing pages can be created quickly using AI-assisted development.

title: Virtual Assistant – Product & Wholesale Supplier Research
description:
We are a Canadian product-based business looking for one reliable Virtual Assistant to research potential resale products and identify wholesale or online-arbitrage suppliers where those products may be purchased.



The main purpose of this position is to create an organized spreadsheet of potentially viable product leads that meet our initial research criteria.



Main Responsibilities

Find potential resale products that meet the research criteria provided

Locate Canadian wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, authorized dealers, retailers, and online-arbitrage sources

Search supplier websites, wholesale catalogs, brand websites, retail websites, and approved marketplaces

Confirm that the exact product is available from the identified supplier

Match products accurately using the UPC, model number, size, quantity, package count, scent, colour, or variation

Record all product and supplier information in a provided spreadsheet

Include direct links to the supplier’s product page and the matching comparison listing

Record the current supplier price

Identify minimum order quantities, case quantities, membership requirements, and wholesale-account requirements

Confirm whether the supplier is located in Canada or ships to Canada

Note whether the supplier appears legitimate and established

Record visible concerns, restrictions, missing information, or unusual requirements

Review supplier catalogs for additional product leads

Follow the written product-research criteria exactly

Avoid submitting products that clearly do not meet the initial criteria

Ask questions when unsure rather than guessing

Product Lead Criteria



Clear product-research requirements will be provided. These may include:



Approved product categories

Minimum or maximum selling-price ranges

Minimum demand or sales indicators

Seller-count requirements

Brands or product types to avoid

Supplier-location requirements

Products that must not be sold directly by certain major retailers

Package-size and variation-matching requirements

Product-condition and authenticity requirements



The VA’s responsibility is to find products that appear to meet these initial criteria and enter them accurately into the spreadsheet for review.



Spreadsheet Information



For each potential product lead, the VA may be required to enter:



Product name

Brand

UPC, SKU, or model number

Size, quantity, package count, or variation

Product category

Supplier name

Supplier type

Supplier country

Current purchase price

Case quantity or minimum order

Supplier product link

Matching comparison-product link

Current listed selling price

Number of visible sellers

Whether a specified major retailer appears to sell the product

Wholesale-account or membership requirement

Shipping availability to Canada

Date researched

Notes, concerns, or missing information



Accuracy is more important than submitting a large number of leads.



Ideal Applicant



The ideal applicant:



Has experience with product research, supplier research, wholesale sourcing, online arbitrage, or e-commerce

Has strong online research skills

Is comfortable using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel

Pays close attention to UPCs, model numbers, package quantities, sizes, and product variations

Understands the difference between manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers, retailers, and marketplaces

Can identify suspicious websites and poor-quality supplier leads

Can follow detailed written criteria without changing the requirements

Does not guess or invent missing information

Communicates clearly when a product or supplier requires further review

Has reliable internet and good written English

Is consistently available for approximately 10 hours per week



Training, product criteria, spreadsheets, and research templates will be provided.



Pay
