title: FULL-TIME SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR — 10 ADS PER DAY, DAYTIME HOURS, LONG-TERM SEAT
description:
FULL-TIME SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR — 10 ADS PER DAY, DAYTIME HOURS, LONG-TERM SEAT

Read this entire post before applying. If you skim it, you will fail the application in the first five seconds and we will both have wasted our time. That is not a threat — it's a favor. This job is not for most people, and I'd rather you find that out now.





WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS

We run paid video ads at real scale. We need volume, every single day, forever.



Your job: produce 10 short-form video ads per day. Different products, different angles, same relentless output.



Most of these are not creative masterpieces. Be clear-eyed about what you'd be doing:



Simple product ads built from footage, images and assets we hand you.

Recreating proven ad structures. We give you a reference ad that's working in the market — you rebuild that format with OUR product, OUR footage, OUR copy. You're reproducing a structure, not copying someone's file.

Working from our swipe file. We keep a reference library of formats that convert. You'll learn it, internalize it, and pull from it fast.

High-volume iteration on winners. When an ad performs, you spin out 10 variations designed to beat it. New hook, new opening 3 seconds, new caption style, new music, new order.



Hooks, captions, pacing, sound. Fast. Clean. Consistent. Every day.



This is not a job where you get to be an artist. This is a job where you get to be the most reliable person in the company. If the word "volume" makes you tired, stop reading. If the idea of one client, one seat, work handed to you every morning, no invoice-chasing, no pitching, no ten-clients juggling act — if that sounds like relief — keep reading.





WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT, IN THIS EXACT ORDER

You show up. Every scheduled day. Not "most days." Not "I had internet problems." Every day.

You clear the day's list. Around 10 ads a day on average. Consistently.

You stay. We are building a team, not renting a freelancer for two months.

Your editing is good enough — and gets better.



Notice that skill is fourth on this list. That is not a mistake. We can teach you our formats, our hooks, our caption style, our pacing — we have a whole system for it, and the person who reads this carefully and types “semla” as the first word in the title when applying for this job is already showing me the exact trait I'm hiring for. It is not mentioned in the title structure, but it is supposed to be the first word, then the title structure. What we cannot teach is a person who is at their desk at the same time every day for the next two years. If you have that, and your edits are decent, you will beat a more talented editor who disappears for three days without a message.





HOURS — AND YES, THEY'RE NORMAL ONES

Monday to Saturday, 8 hours per day, on Philippine time. Roughly 09:00–18:00 PHT with a break. We'll lock your exact hours together before you start.

No graveyard shift. No night work. No waiting up until 2am for a Western client. I start my own day very early, so I'm already online and reachable through most of your workday. You get to sleep at night like a normal human being.

Occasional Sunday pushes when a launch demands it. Paid extra, never assumed, never unpaid.

You keep your regular Philippine holidays. Tell us in advance, that's all.



If you cannot commit to six days a week, every week, do not apply. That is the entire job.





PAY — READ THIS PART SLOWLY

This is a real monthly salary, not piece work. I am not going to pay you per clip and have you racing to grab the easy ones. Some ads take five minutes. Some take an hour. You get paid for clearing the day, not for counting files.



Monthly salary: $520 USD. Paid twice a month, on time, every time. We have never missed a payment and we never will.



On top of that:



$60 USD consistency bonus, every month you clear your daily list on every scheduled day with zero missed days. This is the easiest money in the job and it is entirely within your control.

$50 USD push bonus in any month where you clear meaningfully more than your assigned lists — when we ask for a surge before a launch and you actually deliver it.

$15 USD per winner. Any ad of yours that becomes a top performer in our account. Uncapped, and this is the real upside. More ads out the door means more chances at a winner, which is exactly why we don't need to pay you by the clip to make you fast.

Your first raise comes after ONE month. Not six. Not "we'll see." One month.



The raise ladder, in writing:



When

Monthly salary

With bonuses, realistically

Start

$520

~$580–630

After 1 month

$550

~$610–660

After 3 months

$580

~$640–690

After 6 months

$620

~$680–730





Every step is automatic if you're still clearing your lists. It goes into your agreement on day one. You will never have to ask me for a raise, and I will never "forget."



I put the first raise at one month on purpose. Most clients dangle a raise at six months and half of them never pay it. I'd rather prove to you inside four weeks that when you deliver, the number actually moves — and then keep proving it. Winner bonuses sit on top of every row above.



How the daily target actually works. Every morning you get a list. On a light day that might be twelve quick iterations off a winner. On a heavy day it might be six builds from raw footage. I size the list, not you — so you are never punished for drawing the hard jobs, and never rewarded for cherry-picking the easy ones. Ten a day is the average we're aiming for across a week, not a rule applied to every single day.



What counts as done: delivered on time, follows the brief, correct format and aspect ratio, captions clean, no technical errors. Not a taste judgment. If I send something back I tell you exactly why in one sentence, and it counts once you fix it.





WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

Please save us both the time. Do not apply if:



You are juggling other clients and this would be "one of them."

You need creative freedom and ownership to feel motivated.

Your internet is unreliable and you have no backup connection.

You have no plan for brownouts or power cuts.

You cannot work six days a week.

You want to negotiate the salary upward before you've proven a single month.

You are looking for a placeholder while you search for something better.

You want to "grow into a Creative Director role." That's not this seat.



I'm not being harsh for fun. I hired for this before and lost good people because they wanted a different job than the one I actually had. This time I'm describing it exactly.





HOW TO APPLY — THIS IS THE FIRST TEST

Ninety percent of applicants will get this wrong. That's the point.

1. Subject line, formatted EXACTLY like this:

 | [most short-form ads you've ever finished in ONE day] | [main editing software] | [hours/day you can work] | [days/week you can work] | [your download speed from speedtest.net]



Example: XXXXXX | 8 | CapCut | 8 | 6 | 45mbps



The codeword is written somewhere in this post. I'm not telling you where. If you actually read the whole thing, you already have it.



Wrong format, missing codeword, missing a field — deleted unread. No exceptions, no second chances.

2. Your message must contain these six things, in this order, and nothing else:

Line 1 — The most finished edits you have ever delivered in a single day. Who was it for, and what were they. One or two real sentences. Generic answers are deleted.



Your setup — Computer and specs. Internet provider and speed. Backup internet. What you do when the power goes out. Be specific and boring. "I have good internet" is a failed answer.



Longevity — The longest you have ever stayed in one role or with one client. How long, and why it ended. Be honest. A short history with an honest reason beats an inflated one.



Your work — 2 to 3 links to short-form ads or edits you made. Not a reel. Pick the ones closest to simple product ads. Your judgment about what to show me is part of the test.



One honest answer — What would make you quit this job? Everyone has a breaking point. Tell me yours. I trust the person who names it far more than the person who says "nothing."



Last line — Your single most-used keyboard shortcut while editing, and what you use it for.



Do not attach a generic CV. It will not be read.





THE THREE STAGES

Stage 1 — The application above. Takes 20 minutes if you're serious. Most people won't do it.



Stage 2 — The volume test. Unpaid. If your application is sharp, I send you a folder of raw footage and one reference format. You deliver 3 finished ads within 24 hours. I am not grading beauty. I am grading: did you follow the brief exactly, did you deliver on time, and did you ask smart questions instead of guessing. This is a real preview of the daily job.



Stage 3 — Paid trial week. Full structure, real work, real feedback. This is where the seat is won.





WHAT YOU GET IF YOU WIN IT

One client. One team. Daytime hours. Same work, same people, every day. A real monthly salary paid on time, twice a month, without you ever having to ask. A raise on a schedule, not on a whim — the first one after four weeks. Direct feedback from someone who will tell you exactly what's wrong so you can fix it and get better fast.



If you're the kind of person who is tired of chasing clients and just wants a seat, a number to hit, and to be paid reliably for hitting it — this is that.



Show me you can follow instructions. That's the whole first test.

---

mber, so our hiring process is designed to ensure that we find the right fit for both the applicant and our company.

title: Automation & Systems Specialist
description:
About the Role:

EazePay is looking for an Automation & Systems Specialist to build and maintain the automations that run our funding engine. You’ll take a problem — leads dropping off, a manual step that shouldn’t be manual, a system that doesn’t talk to another system — and turn it into a working automation, end to end. That means diagnosing what’s broken, designing the fix, building it in GoHighLevel, writing the copy that goes inside it, wiring up the integrations, and testing it on real leads before it ships. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who blends technical build skill with marketing instinct, and who reaches for a script when a third-party connector isn’t good enough.



Key Responsibilities:

Revenue Ops & Daily Workflow Management: Own the day-to-day operations for both marketing and sales, building and managing end-to-end automations for lead distribution, pipeline stages, booking flows, sales rep notifications, and marketing nurture sequences.



GoHighLevel Systems Architecture: Build and manage GoHighLevel workflows with complex branching logic, funnels, landing pages, checkouts, pipelines, custom fields, and SMS/email campaigns.



Conversion Copywriting: Write and refine the marketing and sales copy inside automated flows—drafting SMS and
 messaging that feels natural, direct, and human rather than system-generated.



AI-Assisted Workflow & Content Building: Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) as a core part of the building process, priming them with brand, offer, and tone context rather than cold-prompting.



Integrations & Custom Scripting: Wire up integrations between GoHighLevel, Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets), Slack, and internal tools using Zapier, Make, Google Apps Script, webhooks, or direct API calls to keep stack reliance lean and clean.



Diagnostic & Metric-Driven Design: Trace existing workflows step-by-step to spot friction, define clear operational metrics before opening a tool, and build backwards to solve the root problem.



Rigorous Live Testing: Test every marketing and sales automation on real lead scenarios, validating data flow and trigger accuracy before publishing to production.



Documentation & Asset Library: Maintain an organized, repeatable build system—including reusable workflow blocks, copy templates, and prompt libraries—and document every process so teammates can manage it seamlessly.



Requirements & Qualifications:

2+ Years GoHighLevel Experience: Proven track record building custom GHL workflows with complex branching, funnels, and campaigns (Hands-on building experience required; account administration alone is not sufficient. Portfolio or walkthrough expected).



Integration Expertise: Strong fluency in Zapier and/or Make for multi-step scenarios with conditional logic, along with comfort handling webhooks, APIs, and JSON payloads.



Copywriting Skills: Practical ability to write clean, persuasive marketing and sales copy for SMS and
. Note: Copywriting makes up roughly 25% of this role—technical skills without writing ability will not be a fit.



Deliberate AI Usage: Hands-on experience using AI LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) intentionally by setting context, system prompts, and brand guidelines.



Basic Web Standards: Functional working knowledge of HTML and CSS for layout tweaks in funnels,
s, and landing pages.



Workspace & Communication: Deep familiarity with Google Workspace for organization, paired with concise, clear written English for copy, technical documentation, and cross-team communication.



Self-Direction: High ownership—able to diagnose gaps, manage multiple concurrent builds, and hit deadlines independently.



Remote Setup: Reliable high-speed internet, backup power/connectivity, and a quiet home office environment capable of supporting US-aligned business hours.



Nice-to-Have Skills:

Experience writing Google Apps Script or executing direct API requests to bypass third-party connectors.



Experience building, tuning, or integrating AI voice agents (e.g., Retell, Bland AI, Vapi).



Advanced Slack workflow automation and internal communication routing.



Familiarity with n8n, Airtable, or Notion for databases and extended automation.



Background in fintech, merchant funding, lending, or financial services operations.



Prior experience collaborating directly with US-based growth or sales operations teams.



Work Setup, Schedule & Compensation:

Employment Type: Full-time, Remote

Schedule: US-aligned working hours (exact shift times confirmed during the interview process)

Compensation: $800 – $1,100 USD / month (commensurate with experience)



How to Apply

 your resume and evidence of your build work to 
 Use this subject line format: “Automation & Systems Specialist - [Your Name]”

Schedule & Pay

title: Healthcare Operations & Referral Coordinator — QA and HR Administration
description:
About Us



We are seeking an experienced remote Operations and Referral Coordinator to support a U.S.-based behavioral-health and human-services organization and selected administrative functions associated with Our Community Home, Inc.



Our Community Home, Inc. is a Richmond, Virginia nonprofit supporting people facing mental-health challenges, substance-use recovery, housing instability, unemployment, and related barriers through housing, recovery services, mental-health awareness, workforce development, and community programming.



We value compassion, dignity, confidentiality, accountability, professional communication, and measurable follow-through.



About the Position



This is not a basic data-entry position. We need someone who can take ownership of administrative workflows, make sure trackers remain current, follow up on missing documents, communicate professionally with referral partners, and identify when something is at risk of falling through the cracks.



You will work with the Founder/Clinical Director, Office Manager, HR Director, supervisors, and other tea
mbers. You will not replace the Office Manager or HR Director. Your job will be to strengthen oversight, tracking, communication, and administrative follow-through.



What You Will Own

Maintain and improve referral, intake, client-status, HR, credentialing, training, quality-assurance, and document-compliance trackers.

Review assigned trackers each business day and identify overdue, missing, incomplete, or inconsistent items.

Send approved reminder and follow-up
s to supervisors and tea
mbers.

Maintain an escalation log and report repeated or urgent concerns to leadership.

Communicate with referral sources, community partners, treatment providers, and other external stakeholders using approved scripts and communication standards.

Acknowledge referrals, request missing information, document referral status, and make sure follow-ups are completed.

Support the HR Director with administrative tracking, including onboarding checklists, organizational charts, policy acknowledgments, credential expiration dates, training records, and document collection.

Support the Office Manager by assuming non-billing administrative duties that currently compete with billing responsibilities.

Create and update standard operating procedures, checklists,
 templates, workflow maps, and recurring-task calendars.

Prepare a concise weekly red-yellow-green report showing completed items, overdue items, unresolved concerns, referral activity, and decisions needed from leadership.

Check documentation for administrative completeness and timeliness. You will not make clinical determinations or provide clinical supervision.

Protect confidential employee, client, referral, and organizational information.

Escalate clinical questions, safety concerns, complaints, or crisis-related communications immediately rather than attempting to resolve them independently.

What Success Looks Like



During your first 90 days, you will help create:



A reliable central tracking system with clear owners, deadlines, and statuses.

A consistent process for following up on missing documents.

A referral process in which inquiries and referrals are not lost or forgotten.

A weekly leadership report that identifies risks before they become emergencies.

Written SOPs for the organization’s highest-priority recurring workflows.

Clear separation between HR decisions, clinical decisions, billing functions, and administrative follow-up.

Required Qualifications

At least three years of experience in operations coordination, healthcare administration, project coordination, referral coordination, quality assurance, executive assistance, or a similar role.

Experience working with behavioral health, mental health, substance-use services, healthcare, social services, housing, or human services is strongly preferred.

Strong Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel skills, including filters, formulas, conditional formatting, data validation, and organized reporting.

Experience with Google Workspace and at least one project-management, CRM, HRIS, or electronic-record system.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Confidence communicating professionally by
 and, when needed, by phone or video.

Strong judgment about what can be handled independently and what must be escalated.

Ability to work with minimal supervision while providing consistent updates.

A private workspace, reliable internet, backup internet access, and a dependable computer.

Willingness to complete confidentiality, data-security, privacy, and applicable HIPAA training.

Willingness to use multifactor authentication and organization-controlled accounts.

Important Scope Limitation



This role provides administrative coordination and oversight. You will not independently make hiring, firing, disciplinary, compensation, clinical, legal, or regulatory decisions.



How to Apply



Use the subject line:



OCH OPERATIONS 2026



Include all of the following:



Your résumé.

A one- to two-minute video or audio introduction describing your operations or healthcare-administration experience.

A brief example of a tracker, process, or administrative system you improved. Do not include confidential client or employer information.



Your answer to this scenario:



“You begin your day and discover eight new referrals, three supervisors with overdue documents, an expiring staff credential, and two unanswered stakeholder
s. Explain how you would organize, prioritize, document, and escalate the work.”



The software systems you have used.

Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time.

Your desired hourly rate.

Confirmation that you are willing to complete a paid skills assessment.



Generic applications that do not answer the scenario will not be considered.

title: Performance Graphic Designer – Meta Ads | 40+ Creatives Per Week
description:
About the role



We’re Freeflo, an Australian outdoor brand creating reusable ice products for fishing, camping, boating and everyday use.



We’re looking for a dedicated Performance Graphic Designer to work with us on an ongoing basis, primarily creating high-quality static advertising creative for Meta 
 & Instagram).



This is not a traditional brand-design role.



We are looking for someone who understands that paid social creative needs to sell. You should be equally comfortable producing highly polished branded advertisements, raw/direct-response creatives, product comparisons, review ads, problem/solution concepts and attention-grabbing graphics designed specifically for the Meta feed.



Our target is approximately 40 high-quality static ad creatives per week.



Importantly, we are NOT looking for someone to create one design and resize/change the headline 40 times. We want genuine creative variation that allows us to continuously test new angles, concepts, hooks and formats.



What you'll be doing



You will work from our existing brand assets, product photography, customer reviews, UGC, previous winning ads and creative briefs to develop a constant pipeline of Meta advertising creatives.



Your responsibilities will include:



Producing approximately 40 quality static Meta ads per week.

Developing genuinely different creative concepts rather than simply creating variations of the same template.

Turning marketing angles and hooks into compelling visual advertisements.

Designing ads specifically to stop the scroll and communicate the message quickly.

Creating product-focused, lifestyle and direct-response advertisements.

Developing problem ? solution creatives.

Customer review/testimonial ads.

Before/after or comparison-style concepts where appropriate.

Promotional and offer-based creatives.

Educational/product benefit ads.

Fishing, camping and boating-specific creative.

Creating variations of proven winners to identify what elements are driving performance.

Repurposing UGC and lifestyle photography into static ads.

Working with our team to continually improve creative based on Meta performance data.

Maintaining a high level of visual quality despite the volume of output.

The biggest thing we're looking for



We want someone who understands performance creative.



A beautiful graphic that doesn't generate clicks or purchases isn't necessarily a successful ad.



You should understand concepts such as:



Hook ? Problem ? Product ? Benefit ? Proof ? CTA



and know that sometimes an intentionally simple/raw ad can outperform something that looks like a magazine advertisement.



You should be able to look at a product, understand the customer problem and come back with multiple completely different ways of selling it visually.



For example, one product could generate concepts around:



Cost savings

"Never buy ice again"

Ice melting before you've caught your first fish

Keeping a catch cold all day

Servo ice vs reusable ice

Customer reviews

Product demonstrations

Long-term cost comparisons

Australian heat

Remote fishing/camping

Esky organisation

Product durability

Social proof

Promotional offers



We want someone who naturally thinks in terms of angles and concepts, not just layouts.



Volume & expectations



The target is approximately 40 completed static creatives every week.



Quality is extremely important.



We're specifically not looking for:



1 template × 10 headlines × 4 background colours = 40 ads.



Some controlled variations are useful for testing, but the weekly output should contain a healthy number of genuinely new concepts.



We would rather work with someone who can build a repeatable creative system that consistently produces strong ideas at scale.



Creative direction



Freeflo is an Australian brand with a strong and growing customer base across fishing, camping, boating and outdoor recreation.



Our advertising should feel:



Australian. Outdoor. Bold. Clean. Premium. Direct.



We don't want everything to look overly corporate or excessively polished.



Some ads should look premium and heavily designed.



Others should look native to
/Instagram.



Others may deliberately resemble a customer review, screenshot, comparison, meme, diagram or simple product demonstration.



The goal is ultimately performance, not design awards.



Who we're looking for



Ideally, you:



Have significant experience designing Meta/Facebook/Instagram ads for e-commerce brands.

Have worked with high-volume performance creative before.

Understand direct-response advertising.

Can produce high-quality work quickly.

Are comfortable generating ideas rather than waiting for every concept to be dictated to you.

Understand visual hierarchy and mobile-first design.

Can work from existing brand guidelines without making every advertisement look identical.

Are highly proficient in Photoshop and/or equivalent professional design software.

Can perform high-quality photo manipulation and compositing.

Understand how to make physical products look premium.

Can take feedback and iterate quickly.

Have excellent attention to detail.

Understand the difference between brand creative and performance creative.



Experience with outdoor, fishing, camping, 4WD, boating or Australian e-commerce brands would be a major advantage.



What we'll provide



We'll give you access to a large library of:



Professional product photography

Lifestyle photography

UGC

Product videos

Customer reviews

Brand assets

Logos

Previous advertising

Existing winning creatives

Product information

Offers/promotions

Customer pain points

Marketing angles and ideas



We will also provide feedback on which ads are actually performing, allowing you to learn what works for Freeflo and develop better creative over time.



Ongoing relationship



We're not looking for someone to complete 40 ads and disappear.



We're looking for a designer who can become an ongoing part of our creative operation and develop a strong understanding of the Freeflo brand, products and customers.



For the right person, this could become a significant ongoing role.



As you learn what performs, we expect you to become increasingly proactive in suggesting new concepts and identifying opportunities based on previous winners.



When applying



Please include:



Your portfolio of Meta/e-commerce advertising creative.

Examples of static ads you've designed specifically for paid social.

Any examples where you know the ads generated strong results.

Brands you've previously produced performance creative for.

Your experience producing creative at high volume.

Software you primarily use.

Your availability each week.

Your expected weekly/monthly rate for approximately 40 creatives per week.



Please do not send us a general graphic-design portfolio containing primarily logos, websites and branding projects.



We're specifically interested in seeing paid social / e-commerce advertising creative.



Paid trial



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a paid creative trial using one of our products.



We'll provide the same product assets and a basic brief to several shortlisted designers and ask each person to develop a small number of different advertising concepts.



This will allow us to assess not only design quality, but also your ability to think creatively, understand the product and develop advertising concepts that could actually sell it.

As a one person operation, there is a lot of opportunity I am leaving behind. I am looking to hire someone with a strong artistic eye, who is organized, detail oriented, and tech savvy, who I can team up with to take my business further. 



This would include: 



#1: Refreshing my etsy shop with new listings, update outdated text, improve seo and run targeted ads 



*bonus points for spotting SEO trends and helping me cater some art to follow the trending products



#2: Marketing - using seo and google analytics, pin artwork to pinterest and more online platforms in the future such as instagram and tiktok



#3: Book keeping- keep a log of artwork sales for documentation and tax purposes (I will let you know when a piece sells and you can log the information)



#4: Set up platform for wholesale orders of fine art prints 



I'm open to ideas for more possibilities. The more sales we bring in, the more I can hire you to do! I'd love to team up. 



Some skills that would be helpful to have in advance:



- Be familiar with Etsy (on the sellers end)



- Have basic photo editing abilities for the purpose of creating mockups. I use photoshop but the edits are simple. 



- Experience and knowledge with SEO, google analytics, and running online ads



- Experience with pinterest



- Must be passionate about art and working with artists. I need someone more organized than me.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
JOB SCORECARD — SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER (PERSONAL BRAND)

·

MISSION

·

The purpose of this role is to keep content consistently posted and engaging across 4 personal brand accounts 
 
 
 — each spanning 8 platforms: Instagram,
, LinkedIn, Substack, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and YouTube 
 @saltandstories, 
 run on simple CapCut template assembly for short-form content (a separate video editor handles all actual editing), 
 additionally requires custom graphic design work. The role covers both short-form and long-form content across all 4 accounts, with zero missed posts and steady growth in followers/subscribers and engagement.

·

OUTCOMES

·



Consistent Posting — KPI: Posts Scheduled vs. Planned (per account, short-form and long-form) — Measured via Content Calendar (
 / ClickUp) — Target: 100% of scheduled posts go out across all 4 accounts, zero missed — Weekly

Brand Awareness — KPI: Follower/Subscriber Growth — Measured via Native Platform Analytics — Target: Steady month-over-month growth per account — Monthly

Engagement — KPI: Engagement Rate — Measured via Native Platform Analytics — Target: Steady increase in likes/comments/shares/saves/watch time per account — Monthly

Daily Community Presence — KPI: Engagement Activity — Measured via Manual tracking / ClickUp report — Target: Daily engagement across all 4 accounts and all platforms — Daily

Reporting Reliability — KPI: Weekly Report Submitted — Measured via ClickUp — Target: 1 performance report per week covering all 4 accounts, on time — Weekly



·

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

·



Content Calendar & Scheduling: Maintain and manage the posting calendar in 
 across all 4 accounts and 8 platforms. This is the most important part of the role. Nothing gets missed, for any account.

Short-Form Content Assembly 
 @nomakeupedit): Choose a CapCut template, insert provided broll/photos, write the caption using the Claude prompt provided, and schedule in 
. This is template assembly, not video editing — a separate video editor handles all actual editing.

Graphic Design 
 Only): Use the brand kit in Claude AI Design and/or Canva to create static posts, thumbnails, and pins — needs a strong eye for what looks good and on-brand.

Long-Form Content: Post YouTube long-form videos for each account, managing upload, titling, and scheduling.

Pinterest: Create and schedule pins for each of the 4 accounts.

Caption Writing (Long-Form): Write video descriptions/captions for YouTube long-form videos using the Claude prompt provided, per account.

Substack Articles: Write full long-form Substack articles using the Claude prompt provided, per account.

LinkedIn: Adapt and post long-form written content per account.

Coordination with Video Editor: Communicate broll and template needs to the video editor as needed.

Daily Engagement: Engage (replies, comments, DMs) across all platforms for all 4 accounts daily.

Weekly Reporting: Report weekly on performance for all 4 accounts via ClickUp.

Self-Sufficiency: Operate independently day-to-day across all 4 accounts; flag issues rather than needing routine oversight.



·

KEY COMPETENCIES

·



Template Assembly & Eye for Content: Comfortable choosing the right CapCut template and broll combination — no video editing skill required, but needs good judgment on what looks good.

Design Skills 
 Can create polished static graphic designs using Canva/Claude AI Design.

Multi-Platform Fluency: Comfortable posting/managing Instagram,
, LinkedIn, Substack, Pinterest, TikTok, and YouTube (Shorts + long-form).

AI Tool Fluency: Experience using Claude (or similar AI tools) for content generation.

Written English: Strong enough to catch and correct any errors in AI-generated captions/articles across 4 different brand voices.

Organization: Reliable managing content across 4 accounts × 8 platforms simultaneously.

Multi-Brand Awareness: Able to keep 4 distinct account identities/voices straight without cross-contaminating content.

Autonomy: Can manage a multi-account workload without needing regular check-ins or approvals.



·

TOOLS USED

·

Instagram,
, LinkedIn, Substack, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and YouTube long-form (native apps) across 4 accounts 
 
 
 (scheduling), Claude (captions & articles via provided prompts), CapCut (simple template assembly — not editing), Canva & Claude AI Design (graphic design 
 only), ClickUp (task management & weekly reporting).

·

JOB DESCRIPTION

·

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

·

A full-time Social Media Manager to run content across 4 personal brand accounts, each spanning 8 platforms. Three accounts use simple CapCut template assembly for short-form content (a separate video editor handles the actual editing); the fourth 
 also requires custom graphic design work. You'll be given templates, prompts, and brand kits per account; your job is to execute consistently across all 4 and use good judgment.

·

Full-Time Only: This is a full-time role. We are not considering candidates who are part-time or who work other clients on the side.

·

Remote Position: Fully remote.

·

Qualities: Reliable, detail-oriented, self-sufficient, with a good eye for content and design, and able to juggle 4 distinct brand voices.

·

RESPONSIBILITIES

·



Maintain and manage the content calendar in 
 across 4 accounts and 8 platforms — ensuring consistent, uninterrupted posting for each.

Assemble short-form content 
 @saltandstories, 
 choose CapCut template ? insert broll ? write caption (Claude prompt) ? schedule in 
.

Create custom graphic designs (static posts, thumbnails, pins) 
 using its brand kit in Claude AI Design or Canva.

Upload and manage YouTube long-form videos per account, including titles, thumbnails, and scheduling.

Create and schedule Pinterest pins per account.

Write captions/descriptions for YouTube long-form videos using the provided Claude prompt, per account.

Write full Substack articles using the provided Claude prompt, per account.

Adapt and post LinkedIn long-form content per account.

Coordinate with the video editor on broll and template needs.

Engage daily across all platforms for all 4 accounts — replies, comments, DMs.

Work independently across a multi-account workload; flag issues as they come up.



·

EXPERIENCE

·



Proven experience managing multiple social media accounts simultaneously, including both short-form and long-form content.

Comfortable working with CapCut templates (no editing skill required).

Graphic design experience (Canva or similar) 
 static content — please include design samples.

Comfortable using AI tools (Claude or similar) for content generation.

Experience with YouTube, Pinterest, and ideally ClickUp and 
.

Strong written English for proofreading AI-generated content across multiple brand voices.

HOW WE WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED

A pre-built brand kit for each of the 4 accounts for design consistency.

Written Claude prompts for captions, video descriptions, and Substack articles.

A dedicated video editor to handle actual video editing — you're assembling from templates, not editing from scratch.

Clear tools stack (
, ClickUp, CapCut, Canva/Claude AI Design).

Weekly reporting rhythm so feedback happens on a regular cadence, not constant oversight.



·

TIME EXPECTATIONS (40 hrs/week total, scaled for 4 accounts)

·



Content calendar management & overall coordination across 4 accounts × 8 platforms — approx. 5 hrs/week

Short-form content production (template + broll + caption + schedule) 
 
 — approx. 6 hrs/week

Graphic design 
 (Canva / Claude AI Design) — approx. 5 hrs/week

YouTube long-form upload & management across 4 accounts — approx. 4 hrs/week

Pinterest pin creation & scheduling across 4 accounts — approx. 3 hrs/week

Caption/description writing, YouTube long-form (via Claude prompt) across 4 accounts — approx. 1.5 hrs/week

Substack article writing (via Claude prompt) across 4 accounts — approx. 5 hrs/week

LinkedIn long-form adaptation & posting across 4 accounts — approx. 2 hrs/week

Daily engagement across all platforms, all 4 accounts combined — approx. 6 hrs/week (~50 min/day)

Weekly performance reporting across 4 accounts (ClickUp) — approx. 1.5 hrs/week

Coordination with the video editor (broll needs, template requests) — approx. 1 hr/week



Total: 40 hrs/week

·

INTERVIEW / SCREENING QUESTIONS

·



Have you worked with CapCut templates before? Walk me through how you'd choose a template and drop in broll footage.

Can you share graphic design samples (Canva or similar) in the style of financial/lifestyle content

, ClickUp, or similar tools before?

Can you confirm you're available full-time and not currently juggling other clients or part-time work?

title: Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
Note: Interested applicants must submit their initial application exclusively through the OnlineJobs platform. Do not
 the company directly. Any candidate who contacts the company outside of the OnlineJobs system will be disqualified from consideration.



Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant



$6–$8 USD/hour | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time



Every day, dozens of cleaning appointments depend on someone noticing small scheduling problems before they become big ones.



We are looking for that person.



Maid In America Cleaning Services is hiring a highly organized Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant to coordinate mobile cleaning teams, maintain accurate operational data, and communicate with customers when schedules change.



This is not a general administrative assistant role. You must have previous experience scheduling or dispatching employees who travel to customer locations.



What You’ll Do



Your primary responsibility will be helping keep our field operations organized and running on schedule.



You will:

-Prepare and adjust cleaning schedules in Jobber

-Coordinate changes caused by call-outs, delays, and customer rescheduling requests

-Identify overlaps, drive-time issues, staffing conflicts, and other schedule problems

-Reassign or resequence jobs within established guidelines

-Answer inbound customer calls related to scheduling and basic support

-Make outbound calls to communicate delays and schedule changes

-Maintain accurate customer, job, and service information

-Update operational trackers and reports

-Complete invoicing, payroll-support, and cost-of-service tasks

-Escalate decisions that require management approval



You will follow established processes while also using judgment when a situation does not perfectly match the written procedure.



Who We’re Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you:

-Notice small details and inconsistencies others miss

-Work quickly without sacrificing accuracy

-Enjoy solving scheduling and logistics problems

-Follow SOPs, checklists, and operating rules consistently

-Can investigate and solve routine problems independently

-Know when to stop and escalate a decision

-Communicate confidently and professionally with customers

-Stay calm when priorities change

-Learn new software quickly

-Take ownership of mistakes and correct them promptly



Required Experience



You must have previous experience scheduling or dispatching mobile field teams.



Relevant industries may include:

-Residential cleaning

-HVAC

-Plumbing

-Electrical

-Landscaping

-Pest control

-Home health

-Delivery

-Property maintenance

-Other field-service businesses



General calendar management, appointment setting, or meeting scheduling alone does not meet this requirement.



Strongly Preferred

-Direct Jobber experience

-Experience with other field-service platforms

-Customer phone support experience

-Dispatch or logistics experience

-Google Workspace

-Slack

-Spreadsheet and reporting experience



Work Requirements

-Full-time availability

-Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time

-Fluent spoken and written English

-Reliable computer and dedicated workspace

-Reliable internet connection with a backup option

-Backup power solution

-No work for another employer or client during scheduled working hours



Compensation



$6–$8 USD per hour, based on directly relevant experience.



Candidates with direct Jobber experience, mobile-team scheduling experience, and strong customer phone skills will receive priority consideration.



Our Core Values

-Communication

-Connection

-Quality

-Service

-Teamwork



How to Apply



Complete our Culture Index survey:


 



Begin your application subject line with the company core value you identify with most, written in ALL CAPS.



In your application message, include:

-The type of mobile field team you previously scheduled or dispatched

-Approximately how many employees and appointments you coordinated

-The scheduling or field-service software you used

-Whether you have direct Jobber experience

-One example of a scheduling problem you caught before it affected customers or employees



Applications that do not complete the Culture Index survey, follow the subject-line instruction, or demonstrate relevant field-team scheduling experience will not be reviewed.



AI Tool Policy: You may use AI tools only to improve grammar, formatting, or organization. Your examples, reasoning, and answers must be your own. Do not use AI to create generic responses or invent experiences. We may ask you to explain your answers during a live interview. At the end of your response, disclose whether you used AI and how.

title: Static Ad Design (Meta Ads)
description:
Atletico Health is a men's health supplement brand scaling on Meta. Statics are how we screen messaging fast and cheap, and we need someone who can ship a new batch every week.



You will turn our scripts, angles, and claims into scroll-stopping static ads for Feed and Stories. That means native-feel formats (text thread, notes app, review screenshot, forum post), ingredient and mechanism breakdowns, supplement facts callouts, comparison charts, listicles, and clean product-forward hero images. You work from our brand kit and approved messaging, then deliver correctly sized, correctly named, platform-ready files.



Skills required:



Fluent and fast in Figma, Photoshop, or Canvas.

Modular design systems. You build one layout that holds eight headline variants so we can test messaging without a redesign every time

Mobile-first typography. Hierarchy that reads at thumbnail size, on a phone, in half a second

Product compositing and retouching. Our tin has to look real and identical in every ad, dropped into any background convincingly

Infographic and data design: comparison tables, ingredient panels, mechanism diagrams, dosage callouts

Native format fluency. You know what a screenshot ad, a meme ad, and a UGC-photo-with-caption ad look like when they are done right and when they look faked

AI image tooling in the workflow: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Kive, generative fill, for backgrounds, lifestyle scenes, and concept imagery, cleaned up so it does not read as AI

Correct specs and safe zones for 4:5, 1:1, and 9:16

Brand kit discipline. You work inside our type system and palette without needing to be re-told

Working knowledge of the metrics that judge your work: CTR, CPM, and cost per link click



Experience: 2+ years designing static ads that actually ran as paid media on Meta. DTC ecommerce portfolio required. Health, supplement, or fitness a strong plus. Comfortable working from a brief and hitting a recurring weekly deadline.

title: Virtual Assistant (Graphic Design) – Part-Time, 8-16 hrs/week
description:
Are you our next Creative Talent for True Nature?



Are you ready to apply your design skills in Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign directly for an 8-figure German E-Commerce company that is challenging the European market for dietary supplements?



Are you looking for a flexible, part-time remote position where you can contribute to our brand from the front lines?



We are True Nature, an ambitious German company specializing in superfoods, vitamins, and natural dietary supplements. With an 8-figure annual revenue, we are a serious competitor in the EU and are working hard to continuously expand our market position in Germany and Europe. Our mission is to sustainably improve our customers' well-being through holistic, natural products.



As our Virtual Assistant (Design), you will support our Art Director with the ongoing creative production for our growing product range. You will ensure that our product labels, content, and marketplace assets are always accurate, up-to-date, and visually consistent with our brand. Your daily communication will be with our Art Director to ensure smooth handover of briefings and quick feedback loops.



This is a part-time position with a weekly scope of approximately 8-16 hours, depending on current product volume.



Your Main Responsibilities:

You are responsible for the accurate and timely execution of design and content tasks across our existing and new products. Your core tasks are execution-focused, working from clear templates and briefings:

• Product Maintenance: Updating labels and content.

• Amazon Images: Creating productimage variants for Amazon listings.

• New Product Content: Executing content and layout work for new product launches based on briefings from the Art Director (execution, not concept).



What You Bring:

To be successful as our Virtual Assistant (Design), you should possess the following qualifications and attributes:

• Software Skills: Confident use of Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.

• Language Skills: Fluent English (min. C1), especially strong reading comprehension of technical documents (lab certificates, batch records). 

• Work Approach: Detail-oriented execution based on existing templates and layouts 

• Reliability: Independent, structured, and dependable working style.

• Strong Plus: Previous experience in e-commerce or the dietary supplements industry.

• Additional Plus: Experience using AI tools for image generation (e.g., for product mockups, lifestyle imagery, or first content drafts).



What We Offer You:

We want you to feel comfortable and become a long-term part of the True Nature team, working together towards a leading market position.

• Flexible Working Hours: You work 100% remotely with flexible scheduling, coordinated directly with our Art Director for briefings and feedback.

• Growth Environment: Work alongside our creative team and gain insight into the design operations of an 8-figure German E-Commerce brand.

• Direct Communication: Regular consultation with our Art Director ensures clear briefings and fast feedback.

• Company Culture: We operate with honest, open, and transparent communication.



Are you ready to help bring our True Nature brand to life?



Send us a short 2-3 minute video, where you tell us a little about yourself (what you do professionally or have done in the past) and why you would be the best fit for this role, along with 2-3 samples of your design work.



Then apply now and send us your document (CV/Resume), your portfolio/samples, and the link with your video.



We look forward to your application!

title: Teacher Success & Quality Assurance Coordinator (Part-Time, AM Shift)
description:
Exploring Scholar is an education company running one-on-one and small group tutoring for students across North America. We're hiring a Teacher Success & Quality Assurance Coordinator to be the day-to-day point of contact for our growing teacher team.



This is not a generic admin or data entry VA role. You'll be trusted with real judgment calls on coverage, teacher performance, and communications. If you've coordinated a team of 20 or more people before, in education, tutoring, or a similar service business, this is built for you.



Schedule



Part-time, 20 hours per week to start, with strong potential to grow into full-time. Live/sync hours are needed during your early morning (roughly 5am to 9am Philippine time) to overlap with our team's evening hours in Toronto. Remaining hours are flexible and async during your day. We are specifically looking for an early riser who is comfortable and reliable on this schedule.



What you'll own

Quality assurance: Review lesson plans and lesson recordings against our policies. Catch issues before they become patterns.

Coverage arrangements: Arrange substitute tutors for sick days, vacations, or urgent last-minute swaps.

Communications: Send regular updates to teachers and handle one-off announcements. Keep messaging clear and consistent, including proactive phone check-ins with new hires and with teachers taking on new students.

Performance tracking: Monitor ongoing performance, run periodic reviews, gather and give regular feedback to teachers, and flag anything that needs manager attention.

Onboarding: Guide new teachers through our systems and policies, and be their first point of contact in their early weeks.

Proactive problem solving: Spot issues early, whether it's a scheduling conflict, a teacher drifting from policy, or a burnout risk.

Community building: Help our distributed teacher team feel connected and supported, not isolated.

A typical week looks like



Daily morning check-ins on any overnight teacher messages, review of several lesson plans against policy, one or two coverage arrangements handled independently, and a weekly summary sent to the manager, along with meetings with the manager as needed for key updates. You'll make quick phone call check-ins with new hires and with existing teachers when they're assigned a new student, review lesson recordings to monitor teaching quality, and regularly gather and give feedback to teachers.



This is a person-centered, communicative role. You should be comfortable and confident reaching out proactively, by phone as well as by message, rather than waiting for teachers to come to you. Quick phone calls during your shift are a normal, regular part of the job, not an exception.



Long-term opportunity



This is a long-term role with a growing company, not a short-term or trial-only contract. We're looking for someone who wants to build with us as the teacher team and your responsibilities both grow.



What you'll have authority over



You'll be able to make routine calls independently, such as approving standard coverage swaps and handling first-line policy reminders. Anything involving a formal warning, repeated policy violations, teacher conflict, or a parent complaint gets escalated to the manager. Clear guidelines on this will be provided from day one.



Equipment and connectivity



You'll need a reliable laptop or desktop, stable primary internet connection, and a backup plan for outages (a backup internet source or mobile hotspot, and ideally a power backup given occasional brownouts). This role requires dependable daily availability, so please only apply if your setup can support that consistently.



What we're looking for

Excellent written and spoken English

Prior coordination, quality assurance, or team lead experience managing 20+ people (any industry is fine, but education or tutoring is a strong plus)

Comfortable with Zoom and Google Workspace, and quick to learn new systems (we're launching a custom teacher management tool)

Genuinely detail-oriented. This role depends on catching small things before they grow.

Confirmed, reliable availability for the AM shift described above

Warm, relationship-driven communication style

Comfortable initiating phone calls, not just messaging, and proactive about reaching out rather than waiting to be asked

Compensation



$11 to $14 CAD/hour (approximately $8 to $10 USD, exchange rates fluctuate) based on experience, part-time to start (20 hrs/week), with room to grow into a full-time role at a higher monthly rate as responsibilities expand.



Note: When discussing your expected rate in your application, please specify which currency you mean (CAD or USD) to avoid confusion.



Payment: Paid monthly via Wise.



Benefits: As an independent contractor role, this position does not include SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG. 13th month pay available after a full year with the company.



How to apply



Please apply with:



Your resume

A short note on the largest team or roster you've coordinated and what that involved

Confirmation that the AM shift schedule described above works for you long-term

Your expected hourly rate (please specify CAD or USD)



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short scenario-based screening exercise before an interview.

title: Bookings & Customer Support Specialist — Tourism (Remote VA)
description:
Start: Immediate placement for the right person.



We sell tickets for museums, trains and attractions. Our day runs on a live inbox and a booking queue that never stops moving. We need a remote assistant who can work inside that rhythm — fast, accurate, and without needing to be chased.



THE REALITY OF THIS JOB



You will be handling **orders,
s and tasks at the same time, all day**. A booking comes in while you are mid-reply to a customer while a supplier portal is asking you to confirm a time slot. If that sounds stressful rather than normal, this is not the right role for you.



Speed matters, but so does accuracy: a wrong date or a wrong ticket type means a customer standing outside a museum with an invalid reservation.



SCHEDULE — READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING



All hours below are GMT-5 (the same clock as Bogotá or Panama City):



- **Monday–Wednesday:** 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM

- **Thursday–Friday:** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM



Convert this to your own local time before you apply. Please only apply if you can sustain that schedule long term and be fully alert during those hours.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Process ticket reservations across several different supplier platforms and booking portals

- Work the customer inbox daily — clear, correct, well-written replies — plus occasional phone contact

- Handle changes, cancellations, rescheduling and anything that has gone wrong with a reservation

- Keep bookings, confirmations and records organised in Excel and Outlook

- Write and publish travel content (destination guides, attraction tips, practical articles)

- Communicate mainly in English; some written Spanish and Portuguese, with Google Translate and ChatGPT as support tools





WHAT WE ACTUALLY NEED FROM YOU



- **Hands-on ticket reservation experience across multiple platforms** — this is our strongest preference. Tell us which systems you have used.

- **Excellent command of the computer**: Outlook, Excel and Microsoft Office at a confident, everyday-use level, not "basic knowledge"

- The ability to pick up a new tool or website by yourself, in a day, without step-by-step training

- Strong written and spoken English

- Experience with a support desk such as Zendesk is a plus

- Self-management: you plan your own day, track your own open cases and follow up without reminders



HOME OFFICE REQUIREMENTS



- Your own reliable computer (not a phone or tablet) able to run Office and several browser tabs and portals at once

- Stable internet with a backup connection, plus a plan for power interruptions

- A quiet space for calls and a working headset



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF



- You are slow switching between orders,
 and tasks, or you lose track when several things are open at once

- Outlook and Excel are not tools you already use comfortably every day

- You need supervision to stay organised

- You cannot commit to the overnight schedule above



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application with short answers to these three questions. Applications without them will not be reviewed:



1. Which ticket booking platforms or supplier portals have you worked with?

2. Describe a shift where you had a full inbox and multiple bookings at once — how did you organise it?

3. On a scale of 1–10, rate your Excel and Outlook level and give one example of what you do with each.



We would like to hear from you.



Thanks





James

HMO coverage

Leave credits

My core audience consists of real estate investors, including multifamily investors in Chicago and throughout the country. I also want to expand my reach among Chicago property owners, landlords, and investors who may eventually need help selling a property.



The goal is to build a relevant audience that generates investor inquiries, consultations, seller opportunities, appointments, signed clients, and ultimately real estate transactions. I am not looking for someone who only edits videos and uploads them. I want someone who uses analytics, good judgment, and consistent testing to help the content produce better business results over time.



**Weekly volume:**



* Approximately 14 unique short-form videos

* Two videos published every day, including weekends

* Each video posted to TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Snapchat Spotlight

I will record and provide the footage. The content will include talking-head videos, property tours, investing education, real estate analysis, and occasional longer clips that need to be shortened.

**The right candidate:**



* Has strong short-form editing experience

* Understands organic growth and audience retention

* Has excellent English and good creative judgment

* Has personally published content across multiple platforms

Generic applications without relevant examples will not be considered.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer

We are seeking a Senior UX/UI Designer (Contract) to lead the design of high-impact digital experiences across web platforms and marketing-driven initiatives. This is a contract role focused on delivering high-quality, user-centered design work with a strong emphasis on execution, ownership, and results. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to translate business goals and user needs into intuitive, scalable, and high-performing digital experiences.



Required Qualifications

-10+ years of UX/UI design experience with a strong portfolio of web and digital projects

-Proven experience designing and delivering complex websites or digital products

-Strong understanding of UX principles, user flows, and information architecture

-Advanced proficiency in Figma (or equivalent design tools)

-Experience working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments

-Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines independently

-Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions

-Highly detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

-Reliable Fast internet connection

-Must be able to work PST (Pacific Time)



Key Responsibilities

-Design intuitive, user-centered interfaces that balance usability, performance, and visual quality

-Create user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity UI designs

-Design clean, modern, and responsive layouts (desktop & mobile)

-Collaborate with project managers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure smooth execution

-Create and maintain design systems, components, and UI consistency across projects

-Conduct UX audits and recommend improvements to enhance user experience and performance

-Follow brand guidelines and design systems

-Present design concepts and rationale clearly to stakeholders

-Ensure timely delivery of high-quality work across multiple projects



Big Plus - Nice to Have

-Extensive experience working within digital marketing agencies serving U.S.-based clients (5+ years preferred).

-Experience with A/B testing, analytics, or CRO

-Experience designing for WordPress websites

-Familiarity with CSS frameworks or design systems



Contract Details

-Contract / freelance, project-based role (part-time)

-Remote (U.S. Pacific Time / Los Angeles time)

-Compensation: Competitive and commensurate with experience and expertise

-Start Date: Immediate availability preferred



To Apply, Please Include:

1.) Resume (if submitted as a link, please ensure it is publicly accessible and does not require permission or access requests).

2.) Description of your UX/UI experience and share examples of your best work.

3.) Confirm your availability to work PST.

4.) Your wage requirement.



To confirm that you have read and understood this job posting, please begin your application with the phrase 'I AM NOT BOT'

title: Sales Representative
description:
Hours: Up to 40 hours/week

Schedule: Primarily U.S. business hours

Location: Remote; Philippines preferred

Reports to: CEO/Founder



We’re looking for a hands-on Sales Lead to help rebuild and operate the revenue engine for Hirewolf, a local lead-generation business. This is not a basic VA or generic lead-scraping role. We need someone who can execute daily, organize incomplete systems, use AI responsibly, and help turn existing sales assets into real clients and revenue.



Your main mission is to help Hirewolf reach our milestones by building a repeatable sales motion: sourcing qualified prospects, running outreach, maintaining CRM discipline, supporting proposals, following up consistently, and reporting progress clearly. Over time, this role may expand possible path toward sales leadership.



What You’ll Do



Research target niches, cities, and local businesses, then build high-quality prospect lists.



Run outreach through
, calls, LinkedIn, and other channels, with strong follow-up.



Help rebuild CRM workflows, pipeline stages, follow-up reminders, sales reporting, and outreach playbooks.



Customize proposals, one-page summaries, scripts, and follow-up messages based on prospect needs.



Use AI tools to speed up research, drafting, personalization, and process improvement—without sending generic spam.



Track responses, objections, next steps, meetings booked, proposals sent, and revenue progress.



You’re a Great Fit If You Are



Organized, process-driven, and comfortable working in a developing system.



Experienced in business development, SDR/BDR work, lead generation, appointment setting, sales support, or account research.



Confident with written and verbal English, outreach, follow-up, and rejection.



Comfortable using CRMs, spreadsheets, sales tracking tools, and AI tools.



Able to document your work clearly and keep leadership updated without being chased.



Interested in growing into a larger business development or sales leadership role.



Why Join Us



You’ll work closely with company leadership, help revive and grow a real business line, and build systems that can create long-term impact. We value integrity, enthusiasm, a winning attitude, and doing the most right thing. If you enjoy both execution and strategy, and you want your work to be tied to measurable business outcomes, we’d like to hear from you.

description:
MUST HAVE NDIS ALLED HEALTH MARKETING EXPERIENCE



We're a growing NDIS allied health practice on the Gold Coast, and we're looking for a sharp marketing assistant who already understands the NDIS ecosystem.



This is not a "post pretty graphics and hope" role. Our growth comes from referral relationships: Support Coordinators, Plan Managers, Local Area Coordinators, GPs, and other providers. You'll be helping us stay visible, credible, and top-of-mind with those people, while staying strictly compliant with NDIS advertising expectations and the NDIS Code of Conduct.



What you'll do



Plan and schedule content across LinkedIn,
 and Instagram, written for a referrer audience

Build and send EDM campaigns to our referrer database

Design collateral in Canva using our brand kit - service flyers, referral one-pagers, social tiles, capability statements

Maintain and improve our website copy and SEO for local NDIS search terms

Keep our listings current on NDIS provider directories

Track referral sources and campaign performance, and report on what's actually generating enquiries

Draft plain-English, accessible content suitable for participants, families and carers

Help build a simple referrer nurture sequence so warm contacts don't go cold



What you must have



Demonstrated marketing experience with Australian NDIS, allied health, aged care or disability providers - please tell us specifically which

A genuine working understanding of the NDIS: plan management types, the difference between a Support Coordinator and a Plan Manager, how participants find and choose providers

Awareness of NDIS advertising and conduct requirements - including consent and privacy when using participant stories or images

Strong written English. Your copy will be read by Australian clinicians and coordinators, so it needs to sound professional and human, not AI-generic

Canva, Meta Business Suite, and
 marketing platform experience 

Ability to work independently, ask good questions, and flag problems early

Reliable internet and availability overlapping Australian Eastern Standard Time

title: VA Remote Receptionist — Quick Onboarding, Long-Term Role
description:
**IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING**



We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance.



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a call-handling role, we also have a few non-voice positions available, subject to availability and overall fit. If you are interested, please clearly state that you are interested in a non-voice role and submit a brief three-sentence introduction about yourself along with your portfolio or work samples.



Please note our application process: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to respond individually to every applicant who is not selected. If you do not receive a response from us within 24 hours with information about the next step in the hiring process, you were not selected to move forward to the next round. We appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.



————————————————————



**To apply:** Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly. Please answer based on your own personal experience and provide specific, real examples whenever requested. Incomplete, vague, generic, or copied responses may not be considered.



**(1)** Which city and region in the Philippines are you currently located in? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



**(2)** Please submit a link to a screenshot of your internet speed and links to a few samples of your previous work output or portfolio. Please indicate what work you personally completed.



**(3)** Please submit links to two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund.



**(4)** Are you currently employed or engaged in any other work, business, freelance projects, or income-generating activities? If yes, please briefly describe your current commitments and typical weekly availability.



**(5)** Are you able to commit to a fixed 7-day, 6-hour work schedule during Central Standard Time (CST) hours? What is your expected hourly or monthly pay rate and earliest physical start date if hired?



**(6)** Describe three work tasks you have personally completed at least 100 times in a real job. For each task, give a specific example of when you performed the task, explain exactly what you did in your own words, identify the actual tools or systems you used, and describe the final result. Include any specific details, numbers, or challenges you remember from doing the task.



**(7)** If you were hired today, what are three specific work tasks you believe you could fully handle on your own within your first week? For each example, describe the exact task, the tools or software involved, and what successful completion would look like.



**(8)** What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



**(9)** Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

title: Google Ads Specialist for Local Service Business - Account Setup and Management
description:
---- About Ecoshine ----

Ecoshine Window Cleaning is an established window cleaning and exterior cleaning company serving Orange County, Los Angeles County, Long Beach, and surrounding areas of Southern California.

We provide residential and commercial window cleaning, pressure washing, exterior building cleaning, gutter cleaning, screen services, and specialized commercial cleaning.

We are looking for a part-time Google Ads and lead-generation specialist who can work directly with the owner to build our Google advertising system from the beginning.

We do not currently have a fully developed Google Ads system. This position requires someone who can help create the strategy, build the campaigns, install proper tracking, launch the advertising, and manage ongoing optimization.

This is not a basic data-entry or general virtual assistant position.





----- Primary objective -----

Your primary goal will be to build a Google Ads system that produces qualified residential customers and larger commercial opportunities.

We care about qualified leads, booked estimates, sold jobs, revenue, and profitability—not just clicks, impressions, or form submissions.





---- Initial setup responsibilities -----

During the first phase, you will:

Review our business, services, pricing, service areas, and ideal customers

Review any previous Google Ads or Local Services Ads activity

Develop an initial Google Ads strategy

Recommend which services and geographic areas to target first

Build separate residential and commercial campaigns

Conduct keyword research

Create negative keyword lists

Write search advertisements

Set campaign budgets and geographic targeting

Help organize campaign-specific landing pages

Set up telephone-call tracking

Set up form-submission tracking

Configure Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager where needed

Connect lead information to Housecall Pro or another tracking system

Create a reporting process that connects ad spend to qualified leads and sold jobs

Test the system before launching campaigns





----- Ongoing campaign responsibilities -----
