title: Ads Manager / Creative Strategist (Research, Copy & Static Ad Design)
description:
Ads Manager / Creative Strategist (Remote, Full-Time, Long-Term)



Company: Banner Mountain Media

Location: Remote

Role: Ads Manager / Creative Strategist (Research, Copy & Static Ad Design)

Commitment: Full-Time, Long-Term



About Us



Banner Mountain Media is a U.S.-based video production and marketing agency serving home-service businesses, real estate firms, and architecture studios. We run paid advertising that drives real leads (phone calls and form fills) for local businesses, paired with high-quality creative produced in-house.



Role Overview



This is a creative strategist who also runs the ad accounts.



Most of your week is the front half of the work: researching what to say, writing it, and designing it. Then you launch it, read the numbers, and do it again. Research, copywriting, and static ad design are the three things this role lives or dies on. They are not bonus skills here. They are the job.



We need someone who can find the angle before they design anything. That means digging through the Meta Ad Library to see what competitors are running, reading customer reviews to find the words real buyers actually use, and understanding the offer well enough to know which promise will land. Then writing the headline and primary text that carries it. Then building the static ad that delivers it, from the client's own photography, with clean layout and deliberate type hierarchy.



You d
 what to test next, research it, write it, design it, launch it, and prove what worked. Real budget, real creative ownership, results-first.



This role requires consistent availability, reliable performance, and a long-term commitment.



What You Will Do



Research before you create. Tear down competitor ads in the Meta Ad Library, mine customer reviews and sales calls for the language buyers actually use, study the offer, and come back with angles worth testing rather than guesses.



Write the copy. Headlines, primary text, hooks, and CTAs built on direct-response fundamentals. You write to a specific person with a specific problem, not to a general audience.



Design the static ads end to end: layout, typography, composition, and brand consistency across a set of variations that each test a distinct angle.



Work from real client photography (home-service jobs, real estate, architecture) rather than stock. Crop, retouch, and compose it into ads that hold up at thumbnail size.



Own the creative test loop: pick the angle, make the ad, launch it, read the result, and brief our video editors on what to cut next based on what is winning.



Build the full funnel (top, middle, bottom): each new creative tests a clear angle, and winners graduate into more variations.



Own day-to-day buying across Meta and Google Ads for several clients at once: account structure, audiences, budgets, bid strategy, and conversion tracking.



Watch performance daily. Kill underperformers, scale winners, and keep spend pacing to budget against CPL and ROAS targets.



Set up and verify tracking end to end: pixels, conversion events, GA4, UTMs, and CRM/offline conversions.



Report results on a clear schedule in plain numbers and plain language.



Flag policy and compliance risk before launch (Special Ad Categories, financing claims, and similar).



Required Skills & Experience



RESEARCH. You have a repeatable way of finding angles before you create: Meta Ad Library teardowns, competitor analysis, review and testimonial mining, and offer research. You can explain where a winning angle came from, not just that it won.



COPYWRITING. You write ad copy that converts, not copy that describes. Headlines, primary text, hooks, and CTAs. You understand direct-response basics: one clear promise, a specific audience, and a reason to act now. Clear, plain English with no filler.



GRAPHIC DESIGN FOR ADS. You can build a static ad from a client photo with clean layout, deliberate type hierarchy, and consistent branding, and you can explain why it is laid out that way. Not stock photos with a logo dropped on top.



Fluent in a real design tool: Photoshop, Figma, Illustrator, or Canva Pro. You work in layers and can hand off editable files.



Proven static ad experience specifically. Feed, story, and square formats, designed for mobile and legible at thumbnail size.



3+ years hands-on buying on both Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (not boosting posts, not a single platform).



Proven lead-generation experience for local or service businesses (driving calls and form leads, not only e-commerce ROAS).



A track record you can show with real numbers: an account you took from one cost-per-lead to a lower one, or scaled spend while holding CPL/ROAS, plus the ads you researched, wrote and designed for it.



Strong conversion-tracking skills: pixels, GA4, conversion events, and UTM discipline.



Comfortable managing multiple accounts at once without dropping the ball.



Stable high-speed internet and full-time availability with US business-hours overlap.



Preferred (but not required)



Photo retouching and colour correction on real, imperfect field photography.



Landing page copy and CRO instinct (knowing when the problem is the page, not the ad).



Short-form video sense (you can cut or storyboard a Reel/TikTok, or brief an editor precisely).



Motion or animated static ads.



GoHighLevel (GHL) or similar CRM experience.



TikTok and YouTube ads.



Google Local Services Ads (LSA) for home-service clients.



What We Provide



Real budgets and real ownership of client ad accounts and their creative.



A steady supply of original client photography and video to design from. You will not be stuck with stock.



Consistent monthly workload and stable long-term projects.



Clear targets, SOPs, and an in-house video team that turns your briefs into finished assets.



Direct communication with the founder and the rest of the team.



Competitive monthly compensation based on experience and performance.



How to Apply



The first three items matter most. We can read a resume; we cannot read your judgment without them.



1. A research example. Walk us through one angle you found and where it came from. What did you look at, what did you notice, and what did you test because of it?



2. Two or three pieces of ad copy you wrote, with the result if you have it. Headline and primary text is fine. Tell us who it was written for.



3. Three to five static image ads you personally designed, with one line each on the angle it tested and what happened. Send the ads themselves, not just a portfolio link.



4. The design tools you work in (Photoshop, Figma, Illustrator, Canva Pro) and which one you are fastest in.



5. The platforms you have run and roughly how much total ad spend you have managed.



6. One specific result with numbers (cost-per-lead before and after, or a scale while holding CPL/ROAS).



7. The rest of your tools (confir
ta Ads Manager and Google Ads; list GA4, GHL, TikTok, LSA, GTM if you have them).



8. Your expected monthly full-time rate.



9. Your normal working hours and timezone, and confirmation you can commit full-time and long-term.



One more thing, and it is deliberate: when you fill out the intake form we send you, the question about the scheduling and analytics tools you use must be answered starting with the word "northstar". We read every application, and this tells us who reads every job post.

title: Level Up, Engr! Turn Your EE/ECE/ME Degree into a Global Trade Career with Korea
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:



- Company
 Page:





[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or
 



[Closing Message]

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: Funnel Cloning Specialist – Frontend & Backend (Bizopp / Direct Response)
description:
ABOUT US



EVERGREEN APPS is a UK-based performance marketing agency working in bizopp and direct response. A large part of what we do is relaunching offers: a client gives us existing funnel, and we rebuild it as a clean duplicate on new infrastructure so it can go live again fresh.



To be clear on scope: the source funnels are supplied by our clients and are their own property. This is rebuild-and-relaunch work, not scraping other people's assets.





THE ROLE



You take a working funnel and reproduce it completely, frontend and backend, on new infrastructure.



Frontend: rebuild every page in the flow — advertorial, VSL page, order form, upsells, downsells, thank you page. Match the layout, styling and behaviour. Handle the mobile version properly, not as an afterthought. Swap domains, branding and copy where the relaunch calls for it.



Backend: this is where most applicants fall down and where we actually need you. Rebuild the CRM and automation layer in GoHighLevel. Reconnect payment processing and order bumps. Rewire the tracking stack — pixels, conversion APIs, UTMs, server-side events — so attribution is intact from click through to purchase. Rebuild
 and SMS sequences. Set up domains, DNS, SSL and hosting.



Then you test the whole thing yourself. Every button, every step, every trigger, a real test transaction, and a tracking check that fires correctly. We should never be the ones to find a broken link.





WHAT WE NEED



Real experience cloning or rebuilding direct response funnels. Bizopp or make-money experience strongly preferred, because you'll already understand the flow structure and the compliance sensitivities.



Strong AI and clone prompting skills. Solid HTML and CSS — enough to rebuild a page by hand rather than approximate it in a builder.



Genuine competence with tracking. If you can't explain how a conversion event gets from a landing page to Meta's servers, this role isn't for you.



Comfort with domains, DNS, hosting and SSL. Fast, meticulous, and able to spot the difference between "looks the same" and "is the same".





TO APPLY



Send links to funnels you have cloned or rebuilt, and describe what you actually did on each — frontend, backend, or both.



Tell us which CRM and tracking stack you used.



Tell us about a time a rebuild broke something and how you caught it.



Start your message with the word RELAUNCH so we know you read this.



Applications without specific examples will be deleted unread.

title: Local SEO and AI Search Specialist
description:
LOCAL SEO & AI SEARCH SPECIALIST: CLAUDE EXPERIENCE PREFERRED



We are looking for an experienced SEO Specialist to help restoration and home service companies improve their visibility in Google, ChatGPT, and other AI search platforms.



This is a long-term role for someone who understands local SEO, website optimization, and how businesses can become more visible in AI-generated answers.



Experience using Claude is strongly preferred.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Perform SEO audits for client websites

- Research local keywords, services, and target cities

- Optimize service pages and location pages

- Improve titles, headings, content, internal links, and website structure

- Help optimize Google Business Profiles

- Create and improve SEO content using Claude

- Review AI-generated content for accuracy, quality, and search intent

- Improve client visibility in ChatGPT and other AI search results

- Research how competitors and sources are being referenced by AI platforms

- Recommend content, authority, citation, and website improvements

- Track rankings, traffic, leads, and AI search visibility

- Help onboard new clients and implement recommendations



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



- Strong hands-on SEO experience

- Experience with local SEO

- Experience optimizing service-based business websites

- Experience with keyword research and on-page SEO

- Experience creating service pages and location pages

- Understanding of Google Business Profile optimization

- Ability to perform and implement an SEO audit

- Strong written English and attention to detail



AI SEARCH EXPERIENCE



You should have experience or a strong understanding of helping businesses appear in:



- ChatGPT answers

- Google AI Overviews

- Perplexity

- Gemini

- Other AI-powered search and answer platforms



Experience with Generative Engine Optimization, Answer Engine Optimization, AI search optimization, or LLM visibility is strongly preferred.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- Experience using Claude for SEO, research, content, or automation

- Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics

- Experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or similar tools

- Experience with GoHighLevel, webhooks, or automations

WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR



We are not looking for someone who only generates generic AI articles or produces reports without implementing the work.



You must understand SEO strategy, local search intent, content quality, and how to use AI tools without blindly accepting their output.



ABOUT US



We are Ignite Systems, the company behind Restoration AI.



We help restoration and home service companies improve their websites, local rankings, online reputation, AI search visibility, and customer communication systems.



This may begin as a part-time role and grow into a long-term full-time position.

Begin your application with:



Restoration SEO 2026



Applications that do not include this phrase will not be considered.

title: Vendor Compliance & QuickBooks Desktop Coordinator
description:
LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY: VENDOR COMPLIANCE & QUICKBOOKS DESKTOP COORDINATOR



FULL-TIME | REMOTE | $8–$12+ USD PER HOUR | 40 HOURS PER WEEK



Are you exceptionally organized, accurate, and fast on a computer?



A growing U.S.-based construction trucking and logistics company is hiring a full-time Vendor Compliance & QuickBooks Desktop Coordinator.



This is primarily a back-office compliance, document-review, onboarding, and data-entry position. You will review vendor documents, track missing or expiring records, support certified-payroll documentation, and enter approved freight bills into QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop.



Our operation supports approximately 70–150 trucks per day. You must be comfortable working with a high volume of documents, following detailed procedures, identifying discrepancies, and completing repetitive work without sacrificing accuracy.



This is a long-term position reporting directly to the Operations Manager. The company name will be shared with qualified candidates during the interview process.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. REVIEW AND MANAGE COMPLIANCE DOCUMENTS



You will collect, review, organize, and track documents such as:



• W-9 forms

• Certificates of Insurance

• Business licenses

• Driver’s licenses

• Medical cards

• CARB certificates

• DIR registrations

• Certified-payroll onboarding documents

• Payment release forms

• Payroll check documentation

• Audit-related records



You will verify that submitted documents are complete, current, legible, accurate, and consistent with company requirements.





2. SUPPORT VENDOR ONBOARDING AND FOLLOW-UP



You will:



• Send onboarding instructions and document requests

• Follow up through
 and company texting software

• Make occasional phone calls when necessary

• Explain which documents or corrections are still required

• Prepare lists of vendors requiring follow-up

• Maintain accurate onboarding and compliance statuses

• Organize completed vendor files for review

• Record communication and follow-up activity in company systems



After completing training and demonstrating a strong understanding of our requirements, you may be authorized to approve qualifying documents and place or remove designated compliance holds.





3. MAINTAIN CERTIFIED-PAYROLL, AUDIT, AND PROJECT RECORDS



You will:



• Create, distribute, and track certified-payroll onboarding documents

• Maintain project, vendor, and service-date records

• Collect and organize payment releases, payroll records, and audit documents

• Review submissions for missing or inconsistent information

• Update compliance trackers and our custom transportation-management system

• Prepare records for internal compliance and certified-payroll review

• Notify the appropriate tea
mber when documents are missing, inaccurate, expired, or overdue





4. ENTER FREIGHT BILLS INTO QUICKBOOKS ENTERPRISE DESKTOP



Approximately 8–10 hours per week will initially be dedicated to QuickBooks and accounts-payable data entry.



Trucking companies submit daily freight bills that must be reviewed and entered accurately as vendor bills.



You will:



• Review daily freight bills and bills of lading

• Confirm that submitted information matches approved source records

• Enter approved vendor bills into QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop

• Identify duplicate submissions, incorrect rates, missing backup, and other discrepancies

• Contact vendors when corrections are required

• Attach or organize supporting documents

• Complete limited reconciliation and document-matching work

• Escalate unusual discrepancies instead of making unsupported accounting decisions



Information and coding instructions will generally be provided from approved sources. This position does not require you to independently make complex accounting decisions.





5. COORDINATE WITH OUR INTERNAL TEAM



You will:



• Keep the Operations Manager informed of unresolved issues

• Communicate vendor status to Dispatch, Accounting, and Compliance

• Maintain accurate spreadsheets, digital files, and system notes

• Provide concise updates on completed work, pending items, and discrepancies

• Follow established procedures and ask questions when something is unclear

• Protect confidential vendor, driver, payroll, and company information





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS



To qualify, you must have:



• At least 2 years of experience in administrative support, document control, compliance, bookkeeping support, accounts payable, data entry, or another accuracy-focused role



• Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Desktop



• Experience with QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop is strongly preferred



• Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Gmail, Google Docs, and digital file-management systems



• Strong PDF skills, including editing text, combining files, separating pages, renaming files, and organizing high volumes of documents



• Strong written and spoken English



• Excellent reading comprehension and the ability to follow detailed written procedures



• A reliable computer, strong internet, backup internet, backup power, webcam, microphone or headset, and a quiet workspace





THE RIGHT PERSON FOR THIS ROLE



You will be successful if you are:



• Extremely attentive to detail

• Fast and proficient on a computer

• Comfortable with repetitive, high-volume work

• Able to identify inconsistencies instead of blindly entering information

• Organized and disciplined with follow-up

• Comfortable learning many different document types

• Willing to ask questions instead of guessing

• Reliable without constant supervision

• Professional when handling confidential records

• Receptive to feedback

• Interested in staying with one company long-term





PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience in any of the following is helpful, but we are willing to train a highly capable candidate:



• QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop

• High-volume vendor-bill entry

• Accounts payable

• Vendor or subcontractor onboarding

• Compliance-document review

• Certificates of Insurance

• Certified payroll

• U.S. construction administration

• Trucking or transportation administration

• Insurance-document processing

• Reconciliation

• Custom compliance or document-management systems





SYSTEMS YOU WILL USE



• QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop

• Microsoft Excel

• Google Sheets

• Gmail and Google Workspace

• PDF editing and document-management software

• Custom transportation-management and compliance software

• Secure remote-access and VPN tools

• Company
 and texting systems

• Approved time-tracking software



Training will be provided for our company-specific systems, compliance requirements, approval procedures, certified-payroll processes, and freight-bill review procedures.





WORK SCHEDULE



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week independent contractor position, Monday through Friday.



The initial training period will require substantial overlap with Pacific Time business hours. This may require evening or overnight working hours in the Philippines.



Once you are fully trained and consistently completing work accurately:



• At least 4–5 hours of your shift must overlap with Pacific Time business hours

• The remainder of your working hours may become more flexible

• Independent document-processing and data-entry tasks may be completed after U.S. business hours



The final schedule will be agreed upon before hiring.





TRAINING AND ACCOUNTABILITY



During training and the paid probationary period, you must be available for:



• Live video training

• Frequent screen sharing

• Scheduled working sessions

• Quality and workflow reviews

• Regular check-ins with the Operations Manager

• Time tracking through the company’s approved system

• Daily reporting of completed, pending, and unresolved work



As you demonstrate reliability, accuracy, responsiveness, and the ability to work independently, live supervision may be reduced and your schedule may become more flexible.





EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



• A reliable computer capable of supporting remote access

• Strong and stable primary internet

• A dependable backup internet connection

• Backup power for outages

• A working webcam

• A clear microphone or professional headset

• A quiet and professional workspace

• The ability to participate in video meetings and share your screen





COMPENSATION



$8–$12 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



Higher compensation may be considered for an exceptional candidate with strong experience in:



• QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop

• High-volume accounts-payable entry

• Compliance-document review

• Construction or trucking administration

• Certified payroll

• Vendor onboarding

• Reconciliation and discrepancy identification



We are looking for someone who wants stable, long-term work and the opportunity to take on greater responsibility over time.





PAID ASSESSMENT AND PROBATIONARY PERIOD



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a brief paid practical assessment.



The assessment may include:



• Reviewing a sample vendor file

• Identifying missing or inaccurate documents

• Updating a document-expiration tracker

• Reviewing sample freight bills

• Entering sample transaction information

• Identifying an incorrect rate, duplicate submission, missing attachment, or other discrepancy



The selected applicant will begin with a paid probationary period.





GROWTH POTENTIAL



After demonstrating a strong understanding of our procedures, you may receive greater responsibility for:



• Approving compliance documents

• Managing vendor compliance statuses

• Placing or removing designated compliance holds

• Reviewing more complex discrepancies

• Improving document-management processes

• Creating procedures and checklists

• Training future administrative tea
mbers





HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph using this subject line:



ACCURATE DOCUMENTS – [YOUR FULL NAME]



Your application must include:



1. Your resume.



2. A brief explanation of your experience with document review, compliance, vendor onboarding, bookkeeping support, accounts payable, or high-volume data entry.



3. The exact QuickBooks products and versions you have used. Clearly state whether you have experience with:



• QuickBooks Desktop

• QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop

• QuickBooks Online



4. A description of the highest volume of documents or transactions you have processed in a previous position.



5. Your available working hours in both Philippine Time and Pacific Time.



6. Your desired hourly rate in USD.



7. A screenshot of a current internet-speed test.



8. A description of your:



• Computer specifications

• Primary internet connection

• Backup internet connection

• Backup power

• Webcam

• Microphone or headset

• Home-office environment



9. Answer this scenario in 3–5 sentences:



You are reviewing a freight bill and notice that the rate does not match the approved information. A required supporting document is also missing. What would you do before entering the bill into QuickBooks?



10. At the end of your application, include the exact words:



I CHECK BEFORE I ENTER





WHAT HAPPENS AFTER YOU APPLY



Qualified applicants will move through the following process:



1. Application review

2. Short video interview

3. Paid practical assessment

4. Final interview with the Operations Manager

5. Reference check

6. Paid probationary period

7. Long-term full-time engagement



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.

title: Creative Strategist/Video Editor (Ad Agency)
description:
Video Editor & Ad Creative — Make Ads That Sell, Not Just Look Pretty



We're hiring a full-time creative who lives and breathes short-form ads. You'll be the person behind our paid ad creative across TikTok, Meta 
/Instagram), and YouTube — editing scroll-stopping videos, designing static ads, and constantly pitching new hooks and concepts we should test next.



This is a direct-response creative role. We don't care about winning design awards — we care about thumb-stopping hooks, watch time, CTR, and ads that actually convert. If you get excited seeing YOUR ad win the A/B test, this role is for you.



You'll work closely with our Digital Marketing Strategist and business owner on an AI-powered marketing team — we use modern AI tools for scripting, research, and iteration, so you'll spend your time on the creative work that actually moves the needle, not busywork.



What you'll do every week:



Edit short-form video ads — UGC-style edits, hook variations, captions/subtitles, sound design, cutdowns for TikTok, Reels, and Meta feed (this is ~60% of the role)

Design static ads — image ads, carousels, and thumbnails that stop the scroll

Brainstorm new ad concepts — bring us hooks, angles, trends, and formats to test; you'll pitch ideas in every creative meeting, not just wait for briefs

Iterate on winners — take our best-performing ads and produce fresh variations (new hooks, new openers, new formats) to beat the control

Study the data — review which of your ads won and lost, and use that to make the next batch better

Stay on top of trends — you know what's working on TikTok and IG this week, not last quarter



Who we're looking for:



2+ years editing video, with real experience making ads (not just vlogs, weddings, or gaming montages)

Strong with Premiere Pro or CapCut Pro + After Effects (or equivalent); Photoshop/Canva/Figma for statics

You understand direct-response principles: the first 3 seconds d
 everything, captions are mandatory, one idea per ad

A portfolio of short-form ad work you can share (this is required — no portfolio, no interview)

Creative brain, not just technical hands — you generate ideas, you don't just execute briefs

Good written English and reliable communication

Able to work US Pacific business hours (PH night shift) with fast internet, a machine that can handle video editing, and a backup plan for power/internet outages



Nice to have (not required):



Experience with ad creative for e-commerce or DTC brands

Basic motion graphics / animated text skills

Familiarity with AI creative tools (image generation, AI voiceover, script tools)

You've run or helped run ad accounts and understand metrics like CTR, thumbstop rate, and ROAS



Why this role is a great gig:



$800/month starting salary with a clear path to raises — we review performance and pay every 6 months, and creatives whose ads win get rewarded

Long-term, stable, full-time role — we want someone who grows with us for years

Direct access to the business owner and strategist — your ideas actually get tested, fast

Work with a modern AI-powered stack — skills that will keep you ahead of 99% of editors

13th month pay and paid PH holidays after probation (edit/remove to match what you actually offer)



How to apply (read carefully — this is the first test):



Start your application with the word "THUMBSTOP" so we know you read the full post

Link your portfolio — specifically your 3 BEST short-form ad edits (TikTok/Reels/Meta). Tell us which one you're proudest of and why

Pitch us ONE ad idea: pick any product you like, and describe the hook, the first 3 seconds, and why it would stop the scroll

Tell us which editing tools you use daily

Confirm you can work US Pacific business hours full-time



Applications that skip any of these steps will not be read. Creative work is detail work — show us you've got it from the very first message.

title: Amazon Account Specialist
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a sharp, autonomous Amazon Account Specialist to take full ownership of our Seller Central operations. This isn't a role for someone who just follows a script; we need a problem-solver who understands the "why" behind Amazon’s rules and knows how to navigate them effectively. You will be the sole point of contact for customer inquiries, account health, and tactical compliance.



Key Responsibilities

Account Health & "Tactical" Compliance: Monitor account health dashboard daily. Handle restricted product flags, documentation requests, and compliance hurdles. You should be comfortable finding creative, effective ways to resolve "non-traditional" compliance issues and navigating Amazon’s automated systems to keep listings active.



Customer Experience: Manage the daily inbox (typically 1–2 messages per day). Provide high-quality, professional responses that protect our seller rating and resolve buyer issues instantly.



Seller Central Troubleshooting: Act as the primary liaison with Seller Support. Fight for case resolutions, fix stranded inventory, and update listing data as needed. BRAND ANALYTICS is a REQUIREMENT is needed for this role.



Operational Support: General administrative tasks related to the Amazon storefront to ensure "everything is just handled."



The Ideal Candidate

The "Amazon Veteran": You’ve been inside Seller Central long enough to know that "The Rules" and "How things actually work" are often two different things.



Smart & Adaptive: Since volume is low, we don't need a robot. We need someone who can spend their time researching new workarounds or optimizing a process when things are quiet.



High Level of Discretion: You understand the nuances of compliance in the Amazon world and can execute strategies to keep the account safe without overcomplicating simple tasks.



English Fluency: Excellent written English is a must for both customer service and drafting persuasive appeals to Amazon.



Technical Requirements

Proven experience with Amazon Seller Central (specifically Account Health and Case Logs).



Experience handling "difficult" compliance or reinstatement issues is a major plus.



Ability to work independently with minimal daily supervision.
